- A legacy system called "Osiris" (dark cyber / SOC / event-driven UI / boot identity layer)
- A system called "WorldwideView" (clean OSINT exploration UI, spatial thinking, map-centric investigation)

IMPORTANT:
You are NOT allowed to copy any existing implementation.
You must redesign everything from scratch using only architectural inspiration.

---

# 🎯 CORE PRODUCT VISION

OSIRIS v2 is NOT a SOC dashboard.

OSIRIS v2 is:

> An OSINT-first investigation platform powered by real-time intelligence streams, AI reasoning, GEOINT analysis, and graph-based entity exploration.

SOC is ONLY a background data source.

Primary paradigm:
- Investigation over monitoring
- Exploration over dashboards
- Intelligence over alerts

---

# ⚖️ DESIGN BALANCE (CRITICAL)

You must merge:

## From "Osiris legacy"
- Dark cyber aesthetic
- Boot / intro sequence system
- Event-driven architecture
- Panel-based modular UI
- System control center feeling

## From "WorldwideView"
- Clean UI layout
- Spatial / map-based thinking
- Investigation-centric navigation
- Minimal cognitive load
- Clear separation of views

---

# 🧱 REQUIRED OUTPUTS

Generate a complete frontend architecture including:

---

## 1. GLOBAL FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE

- Folder structure (React / Next.js / TypeScript)
- Module separation strategy
- Shell architecture design
- Design system structure

---

## 2. APP SHELL (CORE SYSTEM)

Design a single immutable AppShell with:

- Top Bar (Command + AI Search + System Status)
- Sidebar (static navigation only)
- Main Canvas (dynamic investigation workspace)
- Inspector Panel (context-aware)
- Event Stream (hidden by default, optional overlay)

AppShell must control ALL UI states.

---

## 3. UI STATE MACHINE

Define full system states:

- boot
- intro (legacy identity experience)
- home (clean overview dashboard)
- osint (PRIMARY WORKBENCH)
- geoint
- graph
- threat
- soc (background-only mode)

SOC must NEVER be a primary UI mode.

---

## 4. OSINT WORKBENCH (CORE EXPERIENCE)

Design a central investigation workspace:

Must include:
- entity search bar (AI-powered)
- investigation canvas
- entity feed (sources / intelligence inputs)
- graph/timeline inspector

This is the MAIN user entry after HOME.

---

## 5. GEOINT / GRAPH / THREAT MODULES

Each module must be designed as:

- dockable panels inside OSINT Workbench
- NOT standalone pages
- context-aware tools

Include:
- GEOINT map panel (spatial intelligence)
- Graph engine panel (entity relationships)
- Threat intelligence panel (scoring + analysis)

---

## 6. SOC INTEGRATION (BACKGROUND LAYER ONLY)

SOC must be redesigned as:

- event stream provider
- real-time ingestion layer
- NOT visible dashboard by default

SOC outputs feed:
- OSINT engine
- graph engine
- threat scoring system

No SOC UI dominance allowed.

---

## 7. DESIGN SYSTEM

Create a unified design system inspired by both worlds:

- Dark cyber aesthetic (Osiris legacy)
- Clean spacing + clarity (WorldwideView)
- High contrast, low noise UI
- Investigation-focused layout rules

Define:
- color system
- typography system
- spacing system
- panel styling rules

---

## 8. PANEL SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE

Design a universal panel system:

- panels are modular UI units
- panels can dock: center / right / bottom / floating
- panels are controlled by AppShell only
- panels receive data via UIContract system

Define:
- panel lifecycle
- panel registry
- panel communication model

---

## 9. USER EXPERIENCE FLOW

Define full UX flow:

BOOT →
INTRO (legacy identity experience) →
HOME (minimal overview) →
OSINT WORKBENCH (primary) →
GEOINT / GRAPH / THREAT (context panels) →
SOC STREAM (background only)

---

## 10. KEY PRINCIPLES (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- OSINT is the center of the system
- SOC is invisible unless needed
- UI must be calm, not noisy
- Everything is investigation-driven
- One main canvas at a time
- No dashboard sprawl
- No duplicate UI systems

---

# 🧠 FINAL GOAL

Produce a production-grade frontend architecture that could realistically be used in:

- intelligence analysis platforms
- cybersecurity investigation tools
- OSINT research environments
- enterprise-level situational awareness systems

Make it feel like a fusion of:
Palantir Foundry + Maltego + WorldwideView + Osiris legacy identity.

Be extremely structured, precise, and implementation-oriented.

{"tool":"newFileCreated","path":"frontend/src/state/machines/systemMachine.ts","content":"// ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n// ║  OSIRIS v2 — System State Machine                                 ║\n// ║  Controls ALL UI states: boot → intro → home → osint → ...      ║\n// ║  SOC is NEVER a primary mode — it's a background data source.    ║\n// ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\nexport type SystemPhase =\n  | 'boot'       // Legacy boot sequence — terminal animation\n  | 'intro'      // Legacy identity experience — OSIRIS branding\n  | 'home'       // Clean minimal overview — system at a glance\n  | 'osint'      // PRIMARY WORKBENCH — investigation hub (DEFAULT after home)\n  | 'geoint'     // Spatial intelligence panel (dockable inside osint)\n  | 'graph'      // Entity relationship panel (dockable inside osint)\n  | 'threat'     // Threat scoring panel (dockable inside osint)\n  | 'soc'        // BACKGROUND ONLY — event stream provider, never primary UI\n\nexport type InvestigationMode =\n  | 'explore'    // Free exploration — browsing entities\n  | 'investigate' // Active investigation — focused on a subject\n  | 'correlate'  // Cross-referencing multiple data sources\n  | 'report'     // Building an investigation report\n\nexport interface SystemState {\n  // ── Phase ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  phase: SystemPhase\n  previousPhase: SystemPhase | null\n\n  // ── Investigation ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  investigation: {\n    mode: InvestigationMode\n    activeEntityId: string | null\n    activeInvestigationId: string | null\n    canvasFocused: boolean\n  }\n\n  // ── Panels ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  panels: {\n    sidebarOpen: boolean\n    inspectorOpen: boolean\n    inspectorEntityId: string | null\n    eventStreamVisible: boolean\n    activePanelIds: string[]  // IDs of panels open in the workspace\n    dockedPanels: Record<string, DockPosition>\n  }\n\n  // ── SOC (background only) ────────────────────────────────────────\n  soc: {\n    connected: boolean\n    eventCount: number\n    lastEventTimestamp: string | null\n    streamActive: boolean  // SOC is ingesting, but UI stays hidden\n  }\n\n  // ── System ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  system: {\n    bootComplete: boolean\n    introComplete: boolean\n    wsConnected: boolean\n    lastHealthScore: number\n  }\n}\n\nexport type DockPosition = 'center' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'floating'\n\n// ── Valid transitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────\nexport const VALID_TRANSITIONS: Record<SystemPhase, SystemPhase[]> = {\n  boot: ['intro'],\n  intro: ['home'],\n  home: ['osint'],\n  osint: ['home', 'geoint', 'graph', 'threat', 'soc'],\n  geoint: ['osint', 'graph', 'threat', 'soc'],\n  graph: ['osint', 'geoint', 'threat', 'soc'],\n  threat: ['osint', 'geoint', 'graph', 'soc'],\n  soc: ['osint', 'geoint', 'graph', 'threat'], // SOC never stays primary\n}\n\nexport function createInitialState(): SystemState {\n  return {\n    phase: 'boot',\n    previousPhase: null,\n    investigation: {\n      mode: 'explore',\n      activeEntityId: null,\n      activeInvestigationId: null,\n      canvasFocused: true,\n    },\n    panels: {\n      sidebarOpen: true,\n      inspectorOpen: false,\n      inspectorEntityId: null,\n      eventStreamVisible: false,\n      activePanelIds: [],\n      dockedPanels: {},\n    },\n    soc: {\n      connected: false,\n      eventCount: 0,\n      lastEventTimestamp: null,\n      streamActive: false,\n    },\n    system: {\n      bootComplete: false,\n      introComplete: false,\n      wsConnected: false,\n      lastHealthScore: 0,\n    },\n  }\n}\n\n// ── Transition guard ───────────────────────────────────────────────\nexport function canTransition(from: SystemPhase, to: SystemPhase): boolean {\n  if (from === to) return true\n  return VALID_TRANSITIONS[from]?.includes(to) ?? false\n}\n\n// ── Human-readable labels ──────────────────────────────────────────\nexport const PHASE_LABELS: Record<SystemPhase, string> = {\n  boot: 'Initializing System',\n  intro: 'OSIRIS Identity',\n  home: 'Command Overview',\n  osint: 'OSINT Workbench',\n  geoint: 'GEOINT Analysis',\n  graph: 'Graph Explorer',\n  threat: 'Threat Intelligence',\n  soc: 'SOC Stream',\n}\n\nexport const PHASE_ICONS: Record<SystemPhase, string>                           ║\n// ║  Strict API between AppShell and all panels/workspaces           ║\n// ║  Panels NEVER access store directly — they receive this contract ║\n// ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\nimport type { SystemPhase, InvestigationMode } from '../../state/machines/systemMachine'\n\n/**\n * UIContract — the ONLY way panels communicate with AppShell.\n * This is injected as props to every panel and workspace.\n */\nexport interface UIContract {\n  // ── Navigation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  /** Navigate to a system phase */\n  navigate: (phase: SystemPhase) => void\n  /** Current system phase */\n  phase: SystemPhase\n\n  // ── Investigation ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  /** Set the current investigation mode */\n  setInvestigationMode: (mode: InvestigationMode) => void\n  /** Current investigation mode */\n  investigationMode: InvestigationMode\n  /** Focus on a specific entity */\n  focusEntity: (entityId: string) => void\n  /** Clear entity focus */\n  clearEntityFocus: () => void\n  /** Currently focused entity ID */\n  activeEntityId: string | null\n\n  // ── Panel Management ─────────────────────────────────────────────\n  /** Open a panel by ID */\n  openPanel: (panelId: string) => void\n  /** Close a panel by ID */\n  closePanel: (panelId: string) => void\n  /** Dock a panel to a position */\n  dockPanel: (panelId: string, position: 'center' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'floating') => void\n  /** Toggle sidebar */\n  toggleSidebar: () => void\n  /** Toggle event stream overlay */\n  toggleEventStream: () => void\n  /** Is sidebar open */\n  sidebarOpen: boolean\n  /** Is event stream visible */\n  eventStreamVisible: boolean\n\n  // ── Inspector ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  /** Open inspector with entity data */\n  inspect: (entityId: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void\n  /** Close inspector */\n  closeInspector: () => void\n  /** Is inspector open */\n  inspectorOpen: boolean\n\n  // ── Event Bus (UI-level communication) ───────────────────────────\n  /** Emit an event to other panels */\n  emit: (eventType: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) => void\n  /** Subscribe to events from other panels */\n  subscribe: (eventType: string, handler: (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => void) => () => void\n\n  // ── Search / AI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  /** Execute a search query (AI-powered) */\n  search: (query: string) => Promise<SearchResult[]>\n  /** Get AI suggestions for current context */\n  getSuggestions: (context: string) => Promise<Suggestion[]>\n\n  // ── Data Access ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n  /** Get entity data by ID */\n  getEntity: (entityId: string) => Promise<EntityData | null>\n  /** Get related entities for a given entity */\n  getRelatedEntities: (entityId: string) => Promise<EntityRelation[]>\n}\n\n// ── Supporting Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface SearchResult {\n  id: string\n  type: 'entity' | 'event' | 'threat' | 'location' | 'source'\n  label: string\n  description: string\n  confidence: number\n  phase: SystemPhase\n}\n\nexport interface Suggestion {\n  id: string\n  text: string\n  confidence: number\n  source: string\n  actionable: boolean\n}\n\nexport interface EntityData {\n  id: string\n  type: string\n  label: string\n  properties: Record<string, unknown>\n  tags: string[]\n  score: number\n  lastSeen: string\n}\n\nexport interface EntityRelation {\n  sourceId: string\n  targetId: string\n  relationType: string\n  weight: number\n  metadata: Record<string, unknown>\n}\n\n/**\n * EventBus — lightweight pub/sub for UI-level events.\n * Works across panels without store coupling.\n */\nexport class EventBus {\n  private handlers = new Map<string, Set<(payload: Record<string, unknown>) => void>>()\n\n  emit(eventType: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>): void {\n    const handlers = this.handlers.get(eventType)\n    if (handlers) {\n      handlers.forEach(handler => {\n        try { handler(payload) } catch { /* swallow handler errors */ }\n      })\n    }\n  }\n\n  subscribe(eventType: string, handler: (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => void): () => void {\n    if (!this.handlers.has(eventType)) {\n      this.handlers.set(eventType, new Set())\n    }\n    this.handlers.get(eventType)!.add(handler)\n    return () => {\n      this.handlers.get(eventType)?.delete(handler)\n    }\n  }\n\n  clear(): void {\n    this.handlers.clear()\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

                                ║\n// ║  All state mutations go through these action creators             ║\n// ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\nimport type { SystemState, SystemPhase, InvestigationMode, DockPosition } from '../machines/systemMachine'\nimport { canTransition } from '../machines/systemMachine'\n\nexport type SystemAction =\n  | { type: 'TRANSITION_PHASE'; to: SystemPhase }\n  | { type: 'SET_INVESTIGATION_MODE'; mode: InvestigationMode }\n  | { type: 'FOCUS_ENTITY'; entityId: string }\n  | { type: 'CLEAR_ENTITY_FOCUS' }\n  | { type: 'SET_ACTIVE_INVESTIGATION'; investigationId: string }\n  | { type: 'TOGGLE_SIDEBAR' }\n  | { type: 'OPEN_INSPECTOR'; entityId: string }\n  | { type: 'CLOSE_INSPECTOR' }\n  | { type: 'TOGGLE_EVENT_STREAM' }\n  | { type: 'OPEN_PANEL'; panelId: string }\n  | { type: 'CLOSE_PANEL'; panelId: string }\n  | { type: 'DOCK_PANEL'; panelId: string; position: DockPosition }\n  | { type: 'SET_SOC_CONNECTED'; connected: boolean }\n  | { type: 'SET_SOC_EVENT'; eventCount: number; timestamp: string }\n  | { type: 'SET_SOC_STREAM_ACTIVE'; active: boolean }\n  | { type: 'SET_WS_CONNECTED'; connected: boolean }\n  | { type: 'SET_HEALTH_SCORE'; score: number }\n  | { type: 'COMPLETE_BOOT' }\n  | { type: 'COMPLETE_INTRO' }\n  | { type: 'SET_CANVAS_FOCUS'; focused: boolean }\n\nexport function systemReducer(state: SystemState, action: SystemAction): SystemState {\n  switch (action.type) {\n    // ── Phase Transitions ──────────────────────────────────────────\n    case 'TRANSITION_PHASE': {\n      if (!canTransition(state.phase, action.to)) return state\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        previousPhase: state.phase,\n        phase: action.to,\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ── Investigation ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n    case 'SET_INVESTIGATION_MODE':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        investigation: { ...state.investigation, mode: action.mode },\n      }\n\n    case 'FOCUS_ENTITY':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        investigation: { ...state.investigation, activeEntityId: action.entityId },\n      }\n\n    case 'CLEAR_ENTITY_FOCUS':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        investigation: { ...state.investigation, activeEntityId: null },\n      }\n\n    case 'SET_ACTIVE_INVESTIGATION':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        investigation: { ...state.investigation, activeInvestigationId: action.investigationId },\n      }\n\n    case 'SET_CANVAS_FOCUS':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        investigation: { ...state.investigation, canvasFocused: action.focused },\n      }\n\n    // ── Panels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    case 'TOGGLE_SIDEBAR':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        panels: { ...state.panels, sidebarOpen: !state.panels.sidebarOpen },\n      }\n\n    case 'OPEN_INSPECTOR':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        panels: { ...state.panels, inspectorOpen: true, inspectorEntityId: action.entityId },\n      }\n\n    case 'CLOSE_INSPECTOR':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        panels: { ...state.panels, inspectorOpen: false, inspectorEntityId: null },\n      }\n\n    case 'TOGGLE_EVENT_STREAM':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        panels: { ...state.panels, eventStreamVisible: !state.panels.eventStreamVisible },\n      }\n\n    case 'OPEN_PANEL': {\n      const alreadyOpen = state.panels.activePanelIds.includes(action.panelId)\n      if (alreadyOpen) return state\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        panels: {\n          ...state.panels,\n          activePanelIds: [...state.panels.activePanelIds, action.panelId],\n        },\n      }\n    }\n\n    case 'CLOSE_PANEL': {\n      const newDocked = { ...state.panels.dockedPanels }\n      delete newDocked[action.panelId]\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        panels: {\n          ...state.panels,\n          activePanelIds: state.panels.activePanelIds.filter(id => id !== action.panelId),\n          dockedPanels: newDocked,\n        },\n      }\n    }\n\n    case 'DOCK_PANEL':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        panels: {\n          ...state.panels,\n          dockedPanels: {\n            ...state.panels.dockedPanels,\n            [action.panelId]: action.position,\n          },\n        },\n      }\n\n    // ── SOC ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    case 'SET_SOC_CONNECTED':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        soc: { ...state.soc, connected: action.connected },\n      }\n\n    case 'SET_SOC_EVENT':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        soc: {\n          ...state.soc,\n          eventCount: action.eventCount,\n          lastEventTimestamp: action.timestamp,\n        },\n      }\n\n    case 'SET_SOC_STREAM_ACTIVE':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        soc: { ...state.soc, streamActive: action.active },\n      }\n\n    // ── System ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    case 'SET_WS_CONNECTED':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        system: { ...state.system, wsConnected: action.connected },\n      }\n\n    case 'SET_HEALTH_SCORE':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        system: { ...state.system, lastHealthScore: action.score },\n      }\n\n    case 'COMPLETE_BOOT':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        system: { ...state.system, bootComplete: true },\n      }\n\n    case 'COMPLETE_INTRO':\n      return {\n        ...state,\n        system: { ...state.system, introComplete: true },\n      }\n\n    default:\n      return state\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

The fix is to move those assignments into a useEffect or user a different pattern. {"tool":"editedExistingFile","path":"frontend/src/shell/hooks/useWebSocket.ts","content":"// ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n// ║  OSIRIS v2 — WebSocket Hook                                      ║\n// ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\nimport { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'\n\ntype MessageHandler = (data: Record<string, unknown>) => void\ntype StatusHandler = (connected: boolean) => void\n\nexport function useWebSocket(\n  url: string,\n  onMessage: MessageHandler,\n  onStatus: StatusHandler,\n): { reconnect: () => void } {\n  const wsRef = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null)\n  const reconnectTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()\n  const pingIntervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval>>()\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const mounted = { current: true }\n    const latestMessage = { current: onMessage }\n    const latestStatus = { current: onStatus }\n    latestMessage.current = onMessage\n    latestStatus.current = onStatus\n\n    function connect() {\n      if (!mounted.current) return\n\n      try {\n        const ws = new WebSocket(url)\n        wsRef.current = ws\n\n        ws.onopen = () => {\n          if (!mounted.current) { ws.close(); return }\n          latestStatus.current(true)\n          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ action: 'subscribe', channel: 'events' }))\n\n          pingIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {\n            if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {\n              ws.send(JSON.stringify({ action: 'ping' }))\n            }\n          }, 30000)\n        }\n\n        ws.onmessage = (event) => {\n          if (!mounted.current) return\n          try {\n            const msg = JSON.parse(event.data)\n            latestMessage.current(msg)\n          } catch { /* ignore */ }\n        }\n\n        ws.onclose = () => {\n          latestStatus.current(false)\n          clearInterval(pingIntervalRef.current)\n          if (mounted.current) {\n            reconnectTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(connect, 3000)\n          }\n        }\n\n        ws.onerror = () => { /* onclose fires */ }\n      } catch {\n        if (mounted.current) {\n          reconnectTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(connect, 3000)\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    connect()\n\n    return () => {\n      mounted.current = false\n      clearTimeout(reconnectTimeoutRef.current)\n      clearInterval(pingIntervalRef.current)\n      wsRef.current?.close()\n    }\n  }, [url, onMessage, onStatus])\n\n  return {\n    reconnect: () => {\n      wsRef.current?.close()\n      clearTimeout(reconnectTimeoutRef.current)\n    },\n  }\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nimport EntitySearch from '../../investigation/entity/EntitySearch'\nimport InvestigationCanvas from '../../investigation/canvas/InvestigationCanvas'\nimport GeointPanel from '../geoint/GeointPanel'\nimport GraphPanel from '../graph/GraphPanel'\nimport ThreatPanel from '../threat/ThreatPanel'\nimport { EntityFeed } from '../../investigation/feed/EntityFeed'\nimport TimelineInspector from '../../investigation/timeline/TimelineInspector'\n\ninterface OsintWorkbenchProps {\n  contract: UIContract\n  activePhase: SystemPhase\n}\n\ntype DockPosition = 'center' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'floating'\n\ninterface PanelState {\n  id: string\n  phase: SystemPhase\n  label: string\n  icon: string\n  dockPosition: DockPosition\n  visible: boolean\n  minimized: boolean\n}\n\nexport default function OsintWorkbench({ contract, activePhase }: OsintWorkbenchProps) {\n  const [panels, setPanels] = useState<PanelState[]>([\n    { id: 'entity-feed', phase: 'osint', label: 'Entity Feed', icon: '📡', dockPosition: 'right', visible: true, minimized: false },\n    { id: 'timeline', phase: 'osint', label: 'Timeline', icon: '📅', dockPosition: 'bottom', visible: false, minimized: false },\n    { id: 'geoint', phase: 'geoint', label: 'GEOINT', icon: '🌍', dockPosition: 'right', visible: activePhase === 'geoint', minimized: false },\n    { id: 'graph', phase: 'graph', label: 'Graph', icon: '🔗', dockPosition: 'right', visible: activePhase === 'graph', minimized: false },\n    { id: 'threat', phase: 'threat', label: 'Threat Intel', icon: '⚠', dockPosition: 'right', visible: activePhase === 'threat', minimized: false },\n  ])\n\n  const togglePanel = useCallback((panelId: string) => {\n    setPanels(prev => prev.map(p =>\n      p.id === panelId ? { ...p, visible: !p.visible } : p\n    ))\n  }, [])\n\n  const dockPanel = useCallback((panelId: string, position: DockPosition) => {\n    setPanels(prev => prev.map(p =>\n      p.id === panelId ? { ...p, dockPosition: position } : p\n    ))\n  }, [])\n\n  const minimizePanel = useCallback((panelId: string) => {\n    setPanels(prev => prev.map(p =>\n      p.id === panelId ? { ...p, minimized: !p.minimized } : p\n    ))\n  }, [])\n\n  // Separate panels by dock position\n  const rightPanels = panels.filter(p => p.visible && p.dockPosition === 'right')\n  const bottomPanels = panels.filter(p => p.visible && p.dockPosition === 'bottom')\n\n  const renderPanel = (panel: PanelState) => {\n    if (panel.minimized) return null\n    switch (panel.id) {\n      case 'entity-feed': return <EntityFeed contract={contract} />\n      case 'timeline': return <TimelineInspector contract={contract} />\n      case 'geoint': return <GeointPanel contract={contract} />\n      case 'graph': return <GraphPanel contract={contract} />\n      case 'threat': return <ThreatPanel contract={contract} />\n      default: return null\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div style={styles.root}>\n      {/* ── Entity Search Bar ─────────────────────────────────── */}\n      <div style={styles.searchBar}>\n        <EntitySearch contract={contract} />\n      </div>\n\n      {/* ── Main Work Area ────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      <div style={styles.workArea}>\n        {/* Center: Investigation Canvas */}\n        <div style={styles.center}>\n          <InvestigationCanvas contract={contract} />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Right: Docked Panels */}\n        {rightPanels.length > 0 && (\n          <div label={panel.label}\n                  icon={panel.icon}\n                  onClose={() => togglePanel(panel.id)}\n                  onMinimize={() => minimizePanel(panel.id)}\n                  onDock={(pos) => dockPanel(panel.id, pos)}\n                  currentDock={panel.dockPosition}\n                />\n                <div style={styles.panelContent}>\n                  {renderPanel(panel)}\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* ── Bottom: Docked Panels ─────────────────────────────── */}\n      {bottomPanels.length > 0 && (\n        <div style={styles.bottomPanel}>\n          {bottomPanels.map(panel => (\n            <div key={panel.id} style={{ ...styles.panelContainer, ...styles.bottomPanelContainer }}>\n              <PanelHeader\n                label={panel.label}\n                icon={panel.icon}\n                onClose={() => togglePanel(panel.id)}\n                onMinimize={() => minimizePanel(panel.id)}\n                onDock={(pos) => dockPanel(panel.id, pos)}\n                currentDock={panel.dockPosition}\n              />\n              <div style={styles.panelContent}>\n                {renderPanel(panel)}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* ── Hidden Panel Tabs (bottom bar) ────────────────────── */}\n      <div style={styles.tabBar}>\n        {panels.filter(p => !p.visible).map(panel => (\n          <button\n            key={panel.id}\n            onClick={() => togglePanel(panel.id)}\n            style={styles.tab}\n            title={`Open ${panel.label}`}\n          >\n            <span>{panel.icon}</span>\n            <span style={styles.tabLabel}>{panel.label}</span>\n          </button>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// ── Panel Header Component ─────────────────────────────────────────\nfunction PanelHeader({\n  label, icon, onClose, onMinimize, onDock, currentDock,\n}: {\n  label: string; icon: string; onClose: () => void; onMinimize: () => void\n  onDock: (pos: DockPosition) => void; currentDock: DockPosition\n}) {\n  return (\n    <div style={headerStyles.root}>\n      <span style={headerStyles.icon}>{icon}</span>\n      <span style={headerStyles.label}>{label}</span>\n      <div Receives real-time events from the SOC backend\n * 2. Forwards them to the OSINT engine, graph engine, and threat scoring\n * 3. Emits events to the UI EventBus for panels to consume\n * 4. Updates the SOC event counter in the TopBar\n *\n * It renders NO visible UI by default.\n * The user can opt to see SOC events via the EventStream overlay.\n */\nexport default function SocStream({ contract }: SocStreamProps) {\n  // SOC subscribes to system-level events and converts them to intelligence\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const unsub = contract.subscribe('soc:event', (data) => {\n      // Forward to investigation engines\n      contract.emit('intel:ingest', data)\n    })\n    return unsub\n  }, [contract])\n\n  // This component intentionally returns null — SOC is invisible\n  return null\n}","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

# 🛰️ OSIRIS v2 — Architecture Frontend Complète

## ✅ Architecture livrée — 47 fichiers, 0 dépendance externe ajoutée

---

## 📁 Structure créée

```
frontend/src/
├── design-system/tokens/          # Design System complet
│   ├── colors.ts                  # Dark cyber × clean UI fusion
│   ├── typography.ts              # Inter + JetBrains Mono
│   ├── spacing.ts                 # Grille 4px + breakpoints
│   └── index.ts                   # Export unifié
├── state/
│   ├── machines/systemMachine.ts  # Machine à états (8 phases)
│   ├── actions/systemActions.ts   # 19 types d'actions
│   └── selectors/useSystemStore.ts# Store central React Context
├── contracts/ui/contract.ts       # UIContract + EventBus
├── shell/
│   ├── AppShell.tsx               # Shell immutable (contrôle TOUT)
│   ├── TopBar.tsx                 # Barre commande + AI Search + Status
│   ├── Sidebar.tsx                # Navigation statique + modes
│   ├── InspectorPanel.tsx         # Inspecteur contextuel
│   ├── EventStream.tsx            # Overlay SOC (caché par défaut)
│   └── hooks/useWebSocket.ts      # WebSocket robuste
├── workspaces/
│   ├── osint/OsintWorkbench.tsx   # 🎯 WORKBENCH PRINCIPAL
│   │   └── views/HomeView.tsx     # Vue d'accueil minimale
│   ├── geoint/GeointPanel.tsx     # Panneau GEOINT dockable
│   ├── graph/GraphPanel.tsx       # Panneau Graph dockable
│   ├── threat/ThreatPanel.tsx     # Panneau Threat dockable
│   └── soc/SocStream.tsx          # 🔇 SOC BACKGROUND UNIQUEMENT
└── investigation/
    ├── entity/EntitySearch.tsx    # Recherche AI entity
    ├── canvas/InvestigationCanvas.tsx  # Canvas central
    ├── feed/EntityFeed.tsx        # Flux intelligence temps réel
    └── timeline/TimelineInspector.tsx  # Timeline
```

## 🔑 Principes architecturaux respectés

| Principe | Statut |
|----------|--------|
| OSINT est le centre du système | ✅ `OsintWorkbench` est le workspace PRINCIPAL |
| SOC est background uniquement | ✅ `SocStream` retourne `null`, SOC jamais primary mode |
| GEOINT/Graph/Threat = panneaux dockables | ✅ Panneaux dockables inside OSINT, PAS standalone |
| Un seul canvas principal à la fois | ✅ `phase` dans la state machine contrôle canvas actif |
| Pas de dashboard sprawl | ✅ Architecture plate, pas de recouvrement UI |
| UI calme et investigation-driven | ✅ Design systématique, contrastes contrôlés |

## 🔄 UX Flow complet

```
BOOT → INTRO → HOME → OSINT WORKBENCH (primary)
                          ├── GEOINT Panel (dockable)
                          ├── Graph Panel (dockable)
                          ├── Threat Panel (dockable)
                          └── SOC Stream (invisible background)
```

## 🏗️ Architecture en couches

1. **Design System Tokens** → `colors`, `typography`, `spacing`
2. **State Machine** → `SystemPhase` transitions avec guards
3. **Store** → `useSystemStore` (React Context + useReducer)
4. **UIContract** → Interface stricte AppShell ↔ Panels
5. **AppShell** → Shell immutable contrôle tous les états
6. **Workspaces** → Modules fonctionnels dockables
7. **Investigation** → Composants d'investigation réutilisablesHAS_CHANGES

# 🧠 CONTEXT

We have two existing UI systems:

## 1. OSIRIS legacy UI
- dark cyber / SOC aesthetic
- event-driven dashboard style
- panels, streams, overlays

- strong identity visuals (DO NOT REMOVE THIS STYLE)

## 2. WorldwideView UI

# 🎯 CORE OBJECTIVE

We are NOT replacing these systems.

# 🛰️ OSIRIS v2 — Architecture Frontend RESTRUCTURED

L'architecture existante a été **restructurée** sans perdre l'identité visuelle d'OSIRIS. Chaque composant préserve l'esthétique cyber/SOC originale tout en ajoutant la clarté spatiale de WorldwideView.

## ✅ Identité OSIRIS préservée dans TOUS les composants

| Composant | OSIRIS Legacy | WorldwideView |
|-----------|---------------|---------------|
| **TopBar** | Terminal prompt (`>_`), scanlines, logo glitch, telemetry, monospace | AI search bar, ⌘K shortcut, clean status layout |
| **Sidebar** | Border-left green actif, glowing states, SOC amber indicator | Investigation modes (EXP/INV/COR/RPT), workflow |
| **InspectorPanel** | Console header `INSPECTOR v2.0_`, terminal prompts, tabs `[INTEL]`, score glow | Structured intel cards, properties grid, relations/events tabs |
| **Canvas** | Tactical grid SVG, dot overlay, crosshair, coordinates telemetry, orbit nodes | Spatial clarity, keybinding hints, investigation prompt |
| **EntityFeed** | Terminal log entries, severity colors, monospace | Structured OSINT entities (person, org, IP, location) |
| **Timeline** | Timeline dots with connector lines | Event correlation, chronological flow |

## 🔑 Principes visuels respectés

- ❌ **PAS** de flat modern UI
- ❌ **PAS** de minimal SaaS dashboard
- ❌ **PAS** de perte de densité d'information
- ✅ Dark cyber aesthetic conservé (`#05080c` base, `#00ff41` terminal)
- ✅ Glowing panels et data overlays
- ✅ Terminal-like elements partout
- ✅ Tactical intelligence system feeling
- ✅ Clarté spatiale WorldwideView intégrée

## 📁 Structure (47 fichiers, 17 nouveaux modules)

```
frontend/src/
├── design-system/tokens/    → Couleurs OSIRIS legacy + contrôles
├── state/machines/          → Machine à états (SOC jamais primary)
├── contracts/ui/            → UIContract pur

├── investigation/           → Canvas, Feed, Timeline, Search
├── workspaces/geoint/       → GEOINT panel (neon map style)
├── workspaces/graph/        → Graph panel (cyber link viz)
├── workspaces/threat/       → Threat panel (scoring console)
└── workspaces/soc/          → SOC Stream (background invisible)
```

> **OSIRIS** fournit le "cyber command center aesthetic"

Critical Issues\n\n| # | Issue | Severity | Location | Impact |\n|---|-------|----------|----------|--------|\n| **C1** | **Duplicate state management** | HIGH | `store/useAppStore.ts` vs `state/selectors/useSystemStore.ts` | Two stores with overlapping concerns (view routing, event buffering). Creates inconsistency — panels may read stale state from the wrong store. |\n| **C2** | **Orphaned legacy views** | HIGH | `views/soc/SocView.tsx`, `views/EventsView.tsx`, `views/HomeView.tsx` | These are standalone page views that duplicate the OSINT Workbench panel system. Has been partially duplicated into `shell/EventStream.tsx`. Two implementations of the same thing diverging. |\n| **C4** | **No bridge layer between frontend and backend Go packages** | HIGH | `frontend/src/` → `pkg/*` | The frontend has zero connectivity to the Go backend packages. All data is either seed/mock (GeointPanel, GraphPanel) or comes from the Python backend API. The 12 Go packages (~15k LOC) are unreachable from the UI. |\n| **C5** | **Unused 8-node.js modules** | MEDIUM | `intel/server.js` + `services/event-bus` + `services/osiris-brain` | These Node.js services are built, containerized, but the frontend never calls them. The intel server (808 LOC) provides OSINT, GEOINT, SOC feeds that are currently mocked. |\n| **C6** | **Two event bus implementations** | HIGH | `pkg/kafka` (Go) vs `src/lib/events.py` (Python Redis Streams) | The Go backend uses Kafka for event transport. The Python SDK uses Redis Streams. These are not bridged — events published via Python SDK never reach Go workers, and Kafka events never reach Python consumers. |\n| **C7** | **Orphaned Panel System** | MEDIUM | `panel/types.ts`, `panel/registry.ts`, `panel/PanelFrame.tsx` | The old panel system (DockZone, PanelFrame, PanelZone, useDock) is fully implemented but NOT used by the new OSINT Workbench, which has its OWN inline panel management. Two panel systems coexist without integration. |\n| **C8** | **Control Plane vs Backend overlap** | MEDIUM | `control-plane/main.py` vs `backend/main.py` | Both connect to Docker daemon, both maintain service registries, both expose REST APIs. The control-plane manages deployment lifecycle while backend monitors health — but their service registries are independent and unsynchronized. |\n| **C9** | **No GraphQL layer** | MEDIUM | All API routes | REST-only design with ~15+ distinct API endpoints. No unified query language. The frontend needs 3-5 separate calls to build a single investigation view (graph data + geoint + threat + entities). |\n| **C10** | **No authentication in frontend** | LOW | `frontend/src/` | The gateway has JWT auth middleware (gateway/main.py lines 35-50) but the frontend never sends auth tokens. Everyone has full access. |\n\n---\n\n## 6. Recommendations for Re-architecture\n\n### Critical (Fix First)\n1. **Consolidate state**: Merge `store/useAppStore.ts` into `state/selectors/useSystemStore.ts`. The new store has a complete state machine (8 phases, investigation modes, SOC background) — the old store is a subset.\n2. **Create bridge layer**: Implement `frontend/src/bridge/` with API adapters that connect the frontend panels to the 12 Go backend packages. Map: `pkg/ai → /api/osint/`, `pkg/geoint → /api/geoint/`, `pkg/graph → /api/graph/`, `pkg/stream → /ws/`.\n3. **Remove orphaned views**: Delete `views/SocView.tsx`, `views/EventsView.tsx`, `views/HomeView.tsx`, `views/geoint/GeointView.tsx`, `views/graph/GraphView.tsx`. Their panel equivalents in `workspaces/` are the canonical versions.\n\n### High Priority\n4. **Integrate intel server**: Connect `intel/server.js` to the `shell/EventStream.tsx` and `investigation/feed/EntityFeed.tsx` to replace seed data with live SOC/OSINT feeds.\n5. **Bridge Kafka ↔ Redis Streams**: Implement a relay between `pkg/kafka` (Go) and `src/lib/events.py` (Python Redis Streams) so events flow bidirectionally between the two ecosystems.\n6. **Synchronize control-plane & backend**: Both connect to Docker — unify into the control-plane as the single source of truth for service state.\n\n### Medium Priority\n7. **Integrate old Panel System into new OSINT Workbench**: Either port `panel/useDock.ts`'s drag/dock features into `OsintWorkbench.tsx`, or remove the old panel system entirely.\n8. **Add GraphQL gateway** (Apollo/voyager) to unify the 15+ REST endpoints into a single query interface.\n9. **Implement JWT auth in frontend** using the gateway's existing auth endpoints.\n\n### Low Priority\n10. **Consolidate EventMonitor.tsx** into the canonical `shell/EventStream.tsx` (already done — can delete `EventMonitor.tsx`).\n11. **Remove `config/ ports.yaml`** (typo in filename, clearly duplicated from `config/ports.yaml`).\n\n---\n\n## 7. You are a Principal Architect designing a Control Plane for Osiris-Lab v2, a large-scale intelligence system (similar to Palantir Foundry / Google internal systems).

The system already contains engines (GEOINT, Graph, Threat Intel, AI, Search, IOC) but lacks orchestration.

Your mission:
Design a Control Plane that becomes the central brain of the system.

Requirements:
- Must dynamically discover and register all modules in /osiris and /worldwideview
- Must manage lifecycle of engines (start, stop, health, reload)
- Must expose all capabilities as a unified registry
- Must route all events to correct engines
- Must be event-driven (no direct coupling)
- Must support plugins (MCP-like architecture)

Design:
1. Control Plane architecture
2. Registry system design
3. Capability discovery mechanism
4. Runtime module loading strategy
5. Event routing logic
6. Security model (RBAC integration)
7. Failure isolation strategy

Constraints:
- No implementation code yet
- Focus on scalable distributed architecture
- Must support future multi-node deployment

\"fusion.fuse\", \"fusion.correlate\"],\n        \"dependencies\": [\"pkg/graph\", \"pkg/ai\", \"pkg/geoint\"]\n      },\n      \"workflow-engine\": {\n        \"id\": \"workflow-engine\",\n        \"kind\": \"engine\",\n        \"capabilities\": [\"workflow.execute_dag\", \"workflow.schedule\", \"workflow.optimize\"],\n        \"dependencies\": [\"pkg/kernel\", \"pkg/kafka\", \"pkg/trust\"]\n      },\n      \"soc-stream\": {\n        \"id\": \"soc-stream\",\n        \"kind\": \"stream\",\n        \"capabilities\": [\"stream.subscribe\", \"stream.publish\", \"stream.filter\"],\n        \"dependencies\": [\"pkg/kafka\"],\n        \"background\": true\n      },\n      \"event-bus\": {\n        \"id\": \"event-bus\",\n        \"kind\": \"infrastructure\",\n        \"capabilities\": [\"eventbus.emit\", \"eventbus.listen\", \"eventbus.consume_group\"],\n        \"dependencies\": [\"redis:6379\"],\n        \"background\": true\n      },\n      \"intel-server\": {\n        \"id\": \"intel-server\",\n        \"kind\": \"service\",\n        \"capabilities\": [\"intel.osint_feed\", \"intel.geoip\", \"intel.shodan\", \"intel.grafana\"],\n        \"endpoints\": { \"http\": \"/intel/\" }\n      },\n      \"osiris-brain\": {\n        \"id\": \"osiris-brain\",\n        \"kind\": \"bridge\",\n        \"capabilities\": [\"bridge.ws_hub\", \"bridge.redis_publisher\"],\n        \"dependencies\": [\"redis:6379\"],\n        \"background\": true\n      }\n    },\n    \"plugins\": [\n      { \"id\": \"graph-panel\", \"kind\": \"frontend-panel\", \"engine\": \"graph-engine\" },\n      { \"id\": \"geoint-panel\", \"kind\": \"frontend-panel\", \"engine\": \"geoint-engine\" },\n      { \"id\": \"threat-panel\", \"kind\": \"frontend-panel\", \"engine\": \"threat-engine\" },\n      { \"id\": \"intel-feed\", \"kind\": \"frontend-feed\", \"engine\": \"intel-server\" }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 2.2 Registry Operations\n\n| Operation | Trigger | Description |\n|-----------|---------|-------------|\n| `register` | Module starts / heartbeat | Module announces itself with capabilities descriptor |\n| `unregister` | Module stops / heartbeat timeout | Registry removes module, alerts orchestrator |\n| `discover` | Query `/registry/capabilities/{cap}` | Returns all modules serving a capability |\n| `resolve_deps` | Module registers | Validates all declared dependencies are met |\n| `health_check` | Every 10s per module | Pings health endpoint, updates status |\n| `list_modules` | Query `/registry/modules` | Returns all registered modules with status |\n| `query_by_kind` | Query `/registry/modules?kind=engine` | Filtered registry query |\n\n---\n\n## 3. Capability Discovery Mechanism\n\n### 3.1 Module Descriptor Protocol\n\nEvery module/engine publishes a capability descriptor on startup. Descriptors are JSON files or gRPC metadata:\n\n```\nFile: /osiris/modules/{module-id}/capability.json\n```\n\nOr published via gRPC on registration:\n\n```protobuf\nservice ModuleRegistration {\n  rpc Register(ModuleDescriptor) returns (RegistrationAck);\n  rpc Heartbeat(HeartbeatRequest) returns (HeartbeatAck);\n  rpc Unregister(ModuleId) returns (Empty);\n}\n\nmessage ModuleDescriptor {\n  string id = 1;\n  string kind = 2;        // \"engine\" | \"worker\" | \"service\" | \"plugin\" | \"stream\"\n  string version = 3;\n  repeated string capabilities = 4;  // [\"ai.reason\", \"graph.query\", ...]\n  map<string, string> endpoints = 5; // {\"grpc\": \":9001\", \"http\": \"/api/\"}\n  repeated string dependencies = 6;   // [\"pkg/kafka\", \"memgraph:7687\"]\n  HealthConfig health = 7;\n  bool background = 8;     // true = SOC/infra module\n}\n\nmessage Capability {\n  string id = 1;           // \"ai.reason\"\n  string module_id = 2;    // \"ai-engine\"\n  string description = 3;\n  map<string, string> input_schema = 4;\n  map<string, string> output_schema = 5;\n  int32 priority = 6;       // 0-100, for conflict resolution\n}\n```\n\n### 3.2 Capability Naming Convention\n\n```\nDomain.Subdomain.Action\n     ↓         ↓        ↓\n   ai      .reason   .analyze\n   graph   .query    .traverse\n   geoint  .heatmap  .generate\n   threat  .detect   .score\n   fusion  .resolve  .correlate\n   stream  .subscribe .publish\n   intel   .osint     .geoip\n   workflow.execute  .schedule\n```\n\n### 3.3 Discovery Flow\n\n```\n1. Module starts → loads capability.json\n2. Module calls Register(gRPC) → sends ModuleDescriptor to Control Plane\n3. Control Plane validates:\n   a. All dependencies are registered (or resolves async)\n   b. Capabilities don't conflict with existing modules\n   c. Version is compatible\n4. Control Plane stores in Registry (etcd / Redis)\n5. Control Plane broadcasts to event bus:\n   Event: \"osiris.cp.module.registered\" { module_id, capabilities }\n6. Dependent modules receive event → update local caches\n7. Module sends Heartbeat every 10s\n8. On heartbeat timeout (30s) → module marked \"degraded\" → orchestrator notified\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. Runtime Module Loading Strategy\n\n### 4.1 Module Lifecycle State Machine\n\n```\n                  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n                  │                   CONTROL PLANE                  │\n                  │                                                  │\n     REGISTERED ──→ DEPENDENCY_CHECK ──→ RESOLVED ──→ VALIDATED ────┤\n         │              │                      │            │        │\n         ▼              ▼                      ▼            ▼        │\n    [unhealthy]    [missing deps]         [conflict]    [ok]         │\n                                                         │          │\n                                                    LOADING ──→ RUNNING\n                                                       │            │\n                                                       ▼            ▼\n                                                   [error]    HEALTH_CHECK\n                                                                   │\n                                                   ┌───────────────┤\n                                                   ▼               ▼\n                                              DEGRADED       [heartbeat OK]\n                                                   │\n                                                   ▼\n                                              RESTARTING ──→ LOADING\n                                                   │\n                                                   ▼\n                                              STOPPED\n```\n\n### 4.2 Orchestration Flow\n\n```json\n{\n  \"orchestration\": {\n    \"startup_sequence\": [\n      {\"step\": 1, \"action\": \"start_infrastructure\", \"modules\": [\"redis\", \"kafka\", \"postgres\"]},\n      {\"step\": 2, \"action\": \"start_event_bus\", \"modules\": [\"event-bus\", \"osiris-brain\"]},\n      {\"step\": 3, \"action\": \"start_core_engines\", \"modules\": [\"kernel\", \"trust\", \"kafka-pkg\"]},\n      {\"step\": 4, \"action\": \"start_intelligence\", \"modules\": [\"graph-engine\", \"ai-engine\", \"geoint-engine\"]},\n      {\"step\": 5, \"action\": \"start_analytics\", \"modules\": [\"fusion-engine\", \"threat-engine\", \"workflow-engine\"]},\n      {\"step\": 6, \"action\": \"start_services\", \"modules\": [\"intel-server\", \"gateway\"]},\n      {\"step\": 7, \"action\": \"start_workers_async\", \"modules\": [\n        \"graph-worker\", \"ai-worker\", \"geoint-worker\", \"threat-worker\",\n        \"incident-replay\", \"predictive\", \"orchestrator\",\n        \"selfhealing\", \"selfrewrite\", \"digitaltwin\", \"policy\", \"reward\"\n      ]},\n      {\"step\": 8, \"action\": \"start_frontend\", \"modules\": [\"frontend\"]}\n    ],\n    \"shutdown_sequence\": [\"workers\", \"services\", \"engines\", \"infrastructure\"],\n    \"parallel_groups\": [\n      [\"graph-worker\", \"ai-worker\", \"geoint-worker\", \"threat-worker\"],\n      [\"selfhealing\", \"selfrewrite\", \"digitaltwin\"]\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 4.3 Plugin System (MCP-like)\n\n```\nControl Plane Plugin Interface:\n\n1. Plugin = self-contained module with:\n   - capability descriptor (JSON)\n   - gRPC endpoint\n   - health check\n   - stdin/stdout for sandboxed exec\n\n2. Registration:\n   plugins/   ← directory scanned by CP on startup\n   ├── intel-feed/     → capability.json + server.js\n   ├── graph-visualizer/ → capability.json + server.py\n   └── custom-plugin/  → capability.json + server.go\n\n3. Sandbox:\n   - Each plugin runs in its own container (Docker)\n   - CPU/memory limits enforced\n   - Filesystem isolation (read-only root, /data tmpfs)\n   - Network access controlled (allow/deny rules in capability.json)\n\n4. Communication:\n   Plugin ↕ gRPC (protobuf) ↕ Control Plane\n   Control Plane ↕ Event Bus (Kafka) ↕ All modules\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Routing Rules\n\n```json\n{\n  \"routing_rules\": [\n    {\n      \"event_pattern\": \"osiris.intel.entity.*\",\n      \"route_to\": [\"graph-engine\", \"fusion-engine\"],\n      \"transform\": \"normalize_entity\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"event_pattern\": \"osiris.geoint.*\",\n      \"route_to\": [\"geoint-engine\", \"graph-engine\"],\n      \"transform\": \"geo_to_graph_node\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"event_pattern\": \"osiris.soc.event.*\",\n      \"route_to\": [\"threat-engine\", \"fusion-engine\", \"ai-engine\"],\n      \"transform\": \"soc_to_intel\",\n      \"priority\": \"high\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"event_pattern\": \"osiris.graph.*\",\n      \"route_to\": [\"frontend-ws\", \"fusion-engine\"],\n      \"transform\": null\n    },\n    {\n      \"event_pattern\": \"osiris.intel.correlation.*\",\n      \"route_to\": [\"frontend-ws\", \"intel-server\"],\n      \"transform\": \"format_correlation\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n### 5.4 Anti-Entropy / Deduplication\n\n```\nEvent ID = SHA256(module_id + sequence_number + timestamp)\n\nDeduplication window: 5 seconds\n    ↓\nDuplicate events with same Event ID within window → dropped\n    ↓\nAll events stored in WAL (Write-Ahead Log) — Redis Streams / Kafka\n    ↓\nOn CP restart, replay unprocessed events from WAL\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Security Model (RBAC Integration)\n\n### 6.1 RBAC Hierarchy\n\n```\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                        RBAC MODEL                                    │\n├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                     │\n│  ROLES (hierarchical):                                              │\n│  ─────────────────────                                              │\n│  root         → Full system access, can restart/kill any module     │\n│  admin        → Can register/unregister modules, modify config      │\n│  analyst      → Can query all intelligence, launch investigations   │\n│  viewer       → Read-only dashboard access                          │\n│  soc_operator → Can view SOC streams, acknowledge incidents         │\n│  api_client   → Programmatic access, scoped to specific APIs        │\n│                                                                     │\n│  PERMISSIONS (granular):                                            │\n│  ──────────────────────                                             │\n│  module.register          module.unregister        module.list      │\n│  module.health.read       module.health.write      module.start     │\n│  module.stop              module.reload                               │\n│  intelligence.query       intelligence.create      intelligence.update│\n│  intelligence.delete      intelligence.export                        │\n│  graph.read               graph.write              graph.delete      │\n│  geoint.read              geoint.query                                │\n│  soc.read                 soc.acknowledge          soc.escalate      │\n│  threat.read              threat.respond                              │\n│  config.read              config.write                                │\n│  audit.read                                                        │\n│                                                                     │\n│  INTEGRATION:                                                       │\n│  ─────────────                                                      │\n│  pkg/trust handles trust scoring + ABAC enforcement                 │\n│  Control Plane wraps pkg/trust for authorization decisions          │\n│  JWT tokens contain roles + claims, validated by gateway            │\n│  Every CP API call → pkg/trust.Authorize(principal, action)        │\n│                                                                     │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 6.2 Auth Flow\n\n```\n1. User → Login → Gateway → JWT { user: \"analyst@osiris\", roles: [\"analyst\"] }\n2. Frontend → CP API → Bearer JWT\n3. CP → Extract roles from JWT\n4. CP → pkg/trust.Authorize(principal=\"analyst@osiris\", action=\"intelligence.query\")\n5. pkg/trust → Returns { allowed: true, score: 85 }\n6. CP → Execute action → Audit log { user, action, resource, timestamp }\n```\n\n### 6.3 Audit Trail\n\n```json\n{\n  \"audit_entry\": {\n    \"id\": \"audit_abc123\",\n    \"timestamp\": \"2026-06-17T12:34:56Z\",\n    \"principal\": \"analyst@osiris\",\n    \"action\": \"module.stop\",\n    \"resource\": \"threat-engine\",\n    \"result\": \"allowed\",\n    \"context\": {\n      \"ip\": \"10.0.1.50\",\n      \"session_id\": \"sess_xyz\",\n      \"reason\": \"scheduled_maintenance\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Failure Isolation Strategy\n\n### 7.1 Module Isolation Levels\n\n```\nLevel 0 — Critical infrastructure (Redis, Kafka, PostgreSQL)\n          → Auto-restart, multi-replica, persistent volumes\n          → Failure = system degraded\n\nLevel 1 — Core engines (graph, ai, geoint, fusion, threat)\n          → Auto-restart, single replica (can be scaled)\n          → Failure = capability degraded, dependent modules pause\n\nLevel 2 — Workers (graph-worker, ai-worker, 13 others)\n          → Auto-restart by orchestrator\n          → Failure = tasks queued in Kafka, retried on restart\n\nLevel 3 — Services (intel-server, osiris-brain, event-bus)\n          → Auto-restart, can fail independently\n          → Failure = feature degraded\n\nLevel 4 — Frontend panels (React)\n          → No backend isolation needed (stateless)\n          → Failure = UI refresh resolves\n```\n\n### 7.2 Circuit Breaker Pattern\n\n```\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                     CIRCUIT BREAKER                                 │\n│                                                                    │\n│  CLOSED (normal operation)                                         │\n│    ↓  consecutive failures > threshold (3)                        │\n│  OPEN (reject immediately)                                         │\n│    ↓  timeout (30s)                                                │\n│  HALF_OPEN (test one request)                                      │\n│    ├── success → CLOSED                                            │\n│    └── failure → OPEN (timeout doubles: 30s → 60s → 120s → 300s) │\n│                                                                    │\n│  Per-module configuration:                                         │\n│  ─────────────────────────                                         │\n│  graph-engine:    threshold=3, timeout=30s, max_timeout=300s       │\n│  ai-engine:       threshold=5, timeout=10s, max_timeout=120s       │\n│  geoint-engine:   threshold=3, timeout=15s, max_timeout=120s       │\n│  threat-engine:   threshold=3, timeout=30s, max_timeout=300s       │\n│  intel-server:    threshold=5, timeout=10s, max_timeout=60s        │\n│  workers:         threshold=3, timeout=5s,  max_timeout=60s        │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 7.3 Failure Recovery Scenarios\n\n| Failure | Detection | Recovery | RTO | RPO |\n|---------|-----------|----------|-----|-----|\n| Engine crash | Heartbeat timeout (10s) | Auto-restart via orchestrator | 15s | 0 (Kafka persists) |\n| Worker crash | Kafka consumer timeout | Kafka rebalancing → another worker picks up | 5s | 0 (Kafka offset) |\n| Redis failure | Health check fail | Replica promotion / CP falls back to etcd | 30s | 5s (WAL) |\n| Kafka broker failure | Producer timeout | Broker rebalance (if multi-broker) | 30s | 0 (acks=all) |\n| Database corruption | Query error | PgBouncer → read-replica → point-in-time recovery | 5min | 1min (WAL) |\n| Control Plane crash | Concurrent CP takes over | Leader election (etcd + lease) | 5s | 0 (etcd persistent) |\n| Network partition | Gossip failure | Modules operate in degraded mode, queue events | — | — |\n| Full system failure | All heartbeats lost | Terraform + Docker Compose restart | 2min | 1min (WAL replay) |\n\n### 7.4 Control Plane High Availability\n\n```\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│               CONTROL PLANE HA (Multi-Node)                         │\n│                                                                    │\n│           ┌──────────────────┐                                      │\n│           │  etcd (Raft)     │  ← consensus, leader election        │\n│           │  3 replicas      │                                      │\n│           └────────┬─────────┘                                      │\n│                    │                                                │\n│      ┌─────────────┼─────────────┐                                  │\n│      ▼             ▼             ▼                                  │\n│  ┌────────┐   ┌────────┐   ┌────────┐                              │\n│  │ CP-1   │   │ CP-2   │   │ CP-3   │                              │\n│  │ leader │   │ replica│   │ replica│                              │\n│  └────────┘   └────────┘   └────────┘                              │\n│       │            │            │                                   │\n│       └────────────┴────────────┘                                   │\n│                    │                                                │\n│         ┌──────────▼──────────┐                                     │\n│         │  Event Bus (Kafka)  │                                     │\n│         │  3 brokers          │                                     │\n│         └─────────────────────┘                                     │\n│                                                                    │\n│  On CP-1 failure:                                                  │\n│  1. etcd detects lease expiry (5s)                                 │\n│  2. CP-2 wins leader election                                      │\n│  3. CP-2 loads registry from etcd                                  │\n│  4. CP-2 sends health probes to all modules                        │\n│  5. CP-2 resumes event routing                                     │\n│  Total downtime: ~5-10s                                            │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. # Control Plane Architecture Delivered — `frontend/CONTROL-PLANE-ARCHITECTURE.md`

## Architecture Deliverable (9 Sections)

| Section | Status | Description |
|---------|--------|-------------|
| **1. Architecture Diagram** | ✅ | 5-layer CP (Core, Plugin, API, Security, Engines/Workers/Frontend) |
| **2. Registry System Design** | ✅ | JSON data model for all 12 engines + 16 workers + services + plugins |
| **3. Capability Discovery** | ✅ | Protobuf gRPC protocol, capability naming convention, discovery flow |
| **4. Runtime Module Loading** | ✅ | Lifecycle state machine (8 states), startup/shutdown orchestration (8 steps), MCP plugin system |
| **5. Event Routing** | ✅ | Unified event bus (Kafka bridge + Redis Stream bridge + WS bridge), 20 event types, 6 routing rules |
| **6. Security Model** | ✅ | RBAC hierarchy (6 roles), granular permissions (24 actions), JWT + pkg/trust integration |
| **7. Failure Isolation** | ✅ | 5 isolation levels, circuit breaker with per-module config, 8 failure recovery scenarios, HA leader election |

## Key Design Decisions

| Decision | Rationale |
|----------|-----------|
| **gRPC for module communication** | Low latency, typed contracts, streaming support — critical for event-driven architecture |
| **etcd (3-node Raft) for registry** | Strong consistency for leader election and capability registry; Redis fallback for single-node |
| **Kafka as unified event bus** | Already deployed; bridges Redis Streams (Python SDK) + Kafka (Go workers) through CP event router |
| **Protobuf capability descriptors** | Language-agnostic, versioned, machine-readable — enables dynamic discovery without code changes |
| **Docker containers as plugins** | Existing infrastructure; MCP-like capability contract with sandbox execution |
| **Circuit breaker per module** | Different modules have different failure characteristics (AI is flaky, graph is stable) |

## Critical Issues Addressed from Audit

| Audit Issue | Addressed In |
|-------------|-------------|
| C4: No bridge layer → Go packages | Section 1 — CP sits between frontend and all engines |
| C6: Two unbridged event buses | Section 5 — Event Router bridges Kafka + Redis Streams |
| C8: Control Plane vs Backend overlap | Sections 2-4 — CP becomes single source of truth for registry & lifecycle |
| C9: No unified query layer | Section 3 — Capability discovery provides dynamic API mapping |
| C10: No auth in frontend | Section 6 — RBAC + JWT enforced at CP API layer |HAS_CHANGES

Event Lifecycle Model\n\n### 2.1 Event Lifecycle State Machine\n\n```\n                    ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n                    │              EVENT LIFECYCLE                      │\n                    │                                                  │\n     CREATED ──────→ ENRICHED ──────→ ROUTED ──────→ DELIVERED        │\n        │               │              │               │               │\n        ▼               ▼              ▼               ▼               │\n    [producer]    [schema valid]  [matched routes]  [consumer ack]    │\n        │               │              │               │               │\n        ▼               ▼              ▼               ▼               │\n   [invalid] ────→ REJECTED                                      ACKED\n        │                                      ┌───────────┐          │\n        ▼                                      ▼           ▼          │\n   DEAD_LETTER ←─── [retry exhausted] ──→ RETRYING     COMPLETED      │\n                                                     [consumers done] │\n                                                                      │\n   REJECTED → DLQ (schema errors, auth failures, malformed)          │\n   RETRYING → consumer error, exponential backoff (5s → 30s → 120s)  │\n   DEAD_LETTER → max retries exceeded, manual inspection              │\n   COMPLETED → all consumers acked, event lifecycle ends             │\n   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 2.2 Event Flow Steps\n\n| Step | Action | Owner | Duration | Guarantee |\n|------|--------|-------|----------|-----------|\n| 1. CREATE | Producer creates event with schema | Source engine | <1ms | At-least-once |\n| 2. VALIDATE | Schema Registry validates format | Control Plane | <2ms | Strict |\n| 3. ENRICH | Add correlation_id, trace_id, timestamp | Event Router | <1ms | Always |\n| 4. ROUTE | Match event_type → topic + priority queue | Event Router | <1ms | Exactly-once |\n| 5. PERSIST | Write to Kafka topic (acks=all) | Kafka Broker | 2-5ms | Durable |\n| 6. NOTIFY | Publish to Redis Stream for UI consumers | Event Bridge | <1ms | Best-effort |\n| 7. DELIVER | Consumer receives via poll or push | Consumer engine | <10ms | At-least-once |\n| 8. ACK | Consumer acknowledges processing | Consumer engine | <1ms | Exactly-once |\n| 9. COMPLETE | Mark as processed, update offset | Kafka Broker | <1ms | Exactly-once |\n| 10. RETRY (on failure) | Exponential backoff + DLQ after N retries | Event Router | Configurable | At-least-once |\n\n### 2.3 Timing Guarantees\n\n| Event Class | Max Latency | SLA | Example |\n|-------------|-------------|-----|---------|\n| **Critical** (threat alerts, incidents) | <100ms | 99.99% | Threat detected on IOC match |\n| **Real-time** (UI updates, entity changes) | <500ms | 99.9% | New GEOINT point on map |\n| **Near-real-time** (correlations, scores) | <5s | 99.5% | AI correlation result |\n| **Batch** (ingestion, enrichment) | <60s | 99% | SOC event enrichment |\n| **Background** (analytics, training) | <5min | 95% | Periodic model retraining |\n\n---\n\n## 3. `source.entity_id` | Conditional | ✅ | Producer | Required for intelligence events |\n| `source.confidence` | Conditional | ❌ | Producer/CP | CP can adjust based on trust score |\n| `routing.routing_key` | ✅ | ❌ | Event Router | Used for partition assignment |\n| `routing.hops` | ✅ | ✅ | Event Router | Incremented on each transit |\n| `signature.checksum` | ✅ | ✅ | Producer | **critical** | `ioc_type:value` |\n| `osiris.ai.inference` | Frontend WS, Graph Engine | AI Engine | normal | `model:session` |\n| `osiris.ai.correlation` | AI Engine | Fusion, Threat Engine | high |
