\"compression\": \"Brotli (nginx config), target <200KB initial HTML+JS\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Summary\n\n| Component | Technology | Purpose |\n|-----------|------------|---------|\n| **Framework** | React 18 + Vite + TypeScript | Already deployed, SPA for real-time |\n| **System Store** | useReducer + Context | UI state machine, navigation, session |\n| **Entity Store** | Zustand | Normalized entity cache, graph adjacency |\n| **UI Store** | Zustand | Panel layout, inspector state |\n| **Real-time Transport** | WebSocket (primary) / SSE (fallback) | Bidirectional event streaming |\n| **WebSocket Manager** | Singleton with channel multiplexing | Single connection, routed subscribers |\n| **Graph Visualization** | ReactFlow (SVG <1K, WebGL 1K-10K) | Entity relationship graph |\n| **Map Visualization** | Deck.gl (WebGL, GPU-accelerated) | GEOINT spatial data |\n| **Timeline** | D3.js (custom) | Event streams, incident timelines |\n| **Plugin System** | React.lazy + dynamic imports | Code-split panel loading |\n| **RBAC Views** | Role-filtered panel registry | Analyst/SOC/Viewer/Admin views |\n| **Bundle Optimization** | Code splitting + Brotli | <350KB initial, <750KB total |\n| **Memory Target** | LRU caches + ring buffers | <200MB normal operation |\n\n**Key Design Decisions**:\n\n| Decision | Rationale |\n|----------|-----------|\n| **Keep React 18 + Vite** (not Next.js, not Solid) | Already deployed, SPA architecture fits real-time WS, largest ecosystem for graph/map viz |\n| **Three-store architecture** (not one monolithic store) | Clear separation: system state ≠ entity data ≠ UI layout; avoids re-renders across concerns |\n| **Zustand for entity + UI stores** | Zero boilerplate, TypeScript-first, no context wrapper needed, built-in selectors for performance |\n| **WebSocket over SSE** | Bidirectional required for graph queries + AI inference requests; SSE limited to server→client |\n| **Single WS connection with channel multiplexing** | Avoids TCP connection per panel (6+ panels × 2 connections = 12 TCP); single connection with message routing |\n| **ReactFlow over custom SVG for graph** | Handles viewport virtualization, zoom/pan, minimap, selection out of the box; custom SVG can't scale to 10K+ nodes |\n| **Deck.gl over Leaflet/Mapbox GL for map** | GPU-accelerated WebGL rendering for 100K+ points; built-in aggregation layers (heatmap, hexbin) |\n| **Lazy loading + code splitting** | Analysts don't need GEOINT map when they're on the graph tab; split by panel ensures fast initial load |\n| **RBAC at component level** (not just API) | Ensures sensitive panels (e.g., plugin-manager) are never rendered for unauthorized roles |\n| **Ring buffer for events** | O(1) append/evict prevents unbounded memory growth;     │\n     │ Step 1: Login       │                     │\n     │ POST /auth/login    │                     │\n     │ { email, password,  │                     │\n     │   mfa_code? }       │                     │\n     ├────────────────────►│                     │\n     │                     │                     │\n     │                     │ Step 2: Validate    │\n     │                     │ credentials vs      │\n     │                     │ identity provider   │\n     │                     │ (LDAP / Okta / local)│\n     │                     │                     │\n     │                     │ Step 3: Compute     │\n     │                     │ trust score         │\n     │                     ├────────────────────►│\n     │                     │ GetScore(user_id)   │\n     │                     │◄────────────────────┤\n     │                     │  { score: 85 }      │\n     │                     │                     │\n     │                     │ Step 4: Issue JWT   │\n     │                     │ sign(payload)       │\n     │◄────────────────────┤                     │\n     │ { access_token,     │                     │\n     │   refresh_token,    │                     │\n     │   expires_in }      │                     │\n     │                     │                     │\n     │ Step 5: Store JWT   │                     │\n     │ in httpOnly cookie  │                     │\n     │ + memory (not       │                     │\n     │ localStorage)       │                     │\n     │                     │                     │\n     │ Step 6: API call    │                     │\n     │ Authorization:      │                     │\n     │ Bearer <jwt>        │                     │\n     ├────────────────────►│                     │\n     │                     │                     │\n     │                     │ Step 7: Verify JWT  │\n     │                     │ validate signature, │\n     │                     │ exp, nbf, issuer,   │\n     │                     │ audience            │\n     │                     │                     │\n     │                     │ Step 8: Authorize   │\n     │                     │ action vs roles     │\n     │                     ├────────────────────►│\n     │                     │ Authorize(request)  │\n     │                     │◄────────────────────┤\n     │                     │ { allowed: true }   │\n     │                     │                     │\n     │                     │ Step 9: Proxy       │\n     │                     │ to backend service  │\n     │                     │ (with x-user-id     │\n     │                     │ header)             │\n     │◄────────────────────┤                     │\n     │ 200 { data }        │                     │\n     │                     │                     │\n```\n\n### 2.4 Token Revocation\n\n```json\n{\n  \"token_revocation\": {\n    \"strategy\": \"Redis deny-list for revoked tokens\",\n    \"key\": \"osiris:auth:revoked:{jti}\",\n    \"ttl\": \"Same as token TTL (auto-cleanup)\",\n    \"triggers\": [\n      \"User explicitly logs out\",\n      \"Password change\",\n      \"MFA reset\",\n      \"Account suspension\",\n      \"Admin force-logout\",\n      \"Device reported stolen\"\n    ],\n    \"performance\": \"O(1) lookup, <1ms overhead\",\n    \"fallback\": \"On Redis down → allow (graceful degradation), audit anomalous patterns\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. Permission Propagation Model\n\n### 4.1 Propagation Chain\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    PERMISSION PROPAGATION CHAIN                           │\n│                                                                          │\n│  User Request ──→ Gateway ──→ Control Plane ──→ Engine ──→ Plugin      │\n│       │              │              │              │           │         │\n│       ▼              ▼              ▼              ▼           ▼         │\n│  JWT token      Validate JWT    Authorize      gRPC call    Plugin       │\n│  contains       + extract       action vs      carries      capability   │\n│  roles +        roles +         policy         x-user-id    call with    │\n│  permissions    permissions     + trust        + x-role      user context│\n│                                 score          headers                   │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Each hop propagates:                                                    │\n│  - x-user-id (original requester)                                       │\n│  - x-roles (space-separated role list)                                  │\n│  - x-permissions (space-separated permission list)                      │\n│  - x-trust-score (0-100)                                                │\n│  - x-request-id (correlation ID for audit)                              │\n│  - x-tenant-id (for multi-tenant)                                       │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 4.2 Authorization Decision Flow\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    AUTHORIZATION DECISION FLOW                            │\n│                                                                          │\n│  INPUT:  JWT token, action, resource, context                           │\n│                                                                          │\n│  1. EXTRACT: user_id, roles, permissions from JWT                       │\n│  2. CHECK: JWT not revoked (Redis deny-list)                            │\n│  3. RESOLVE: resource type and required permission                      │\n│  4. MATCH: user permission vs required permission                        │\n│     ├── Has permission? → Continue                                      │\n│     └── No permission? → DENY (403) + audit log                        │\n│  5. CHECK: resource-level restrictions (e.g., tenant isolation)         │\n│     ├── Authorized for resource? → Continue                             │\n│     └── Not authorized? → DENY (403) + audit log                       │\n│  6. COMPUTE: trust score via pkg/trust                                  │\n│     ├── trust_score > threshold (default: 30) → Allow                  │\n│     └── trust_score < threshold → DENY (401) + audit log               │\n│  7. ENFORCE: rate limits per user/role                                  │\n│     ├── Within limits? → Continue                                        │\n│     └── Exceeded? → DENY (429) + audit log                             │\n│  8. LOG: full audit entry                                               │\n│  9. ALLOW: propagate headers, proxy to backend                          │\n│                                                                          │\n│  DECISION CACHE:                                                         │\n│  - Cache positive decisions for 60s (key: user_id+action+resource)      │\n│  - Cache negative decisions for 300s (throttle brute force)             │\n│  - Invalidate on role change, permission update, trust score change     │\n│                                                                          │\n│  OVERRIDE:                                                               │\n│  - Admin can force-allow specific actions for troubleshooting           │\n│  - Override logged with full audit trail                                 │\n│  - Override auto-expires after 24h                                      │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 4.3 Service-to-Service Auth (mTLS)\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    SERVICE-TO-SERVICE AUTH (mTLS)                         │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Within the cluster, ALL communication is mTLS:                         │\n│                                                                          │\n│  ┌──────────┐                               ┌──────────┐                 │\n│  │  Engine A │────── mTLS (mutual TLS) ──────▶│  Engine B │                 │\n│  │  (Go)     │◀──────────────────────────────│  (Go)     │                 │\n│  └──────────┘                               └──────────┘                 │\n│       │                                         │                         │\n│       │  Certificate issued by internal CA      │                         │\n│       │  (osiris-ca, one per service)          │                         │\n│       │                                         │                         │\n│  Cert: /etc/osiris/certs/engine-a.crt          │                         │\n│  Key:  /etc/osiris/certs/engine-a.key          │                         │\n│  CA:   /etc/osiris/certs/osiris-ca.crt         │                         │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Validation:                                                             │\n│  1. Client cert signed by osiris-ca → trust                             │\n│  2. CN matches expected service name → allow                             │\n│  3. Cert not expired → allow                                             │\n│  4. Cert not revoked (CRL) → allow                                      │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Policy:                                                                 │\n│  - engine-a can only call graph-engine on port 9002                     │\n│  - geoint-engine can publish to osiris.geoint.* topics                  │\n│  - Frontend can only call gateway on :8080 (no direct engine access)    │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Secure Plugin Execution Model\n\n### 5.1 Plugin Security Levels\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    PLUGIN SECURITY LEVELS                                 │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                          │\n│  Level 0 — SYSTEM PLUGINS (Control Plane, Kernel, Event Bus)            │\n│  ├── Full network access                                                 │\n│  ├── Full filesystem access                                              │\n│  ├── No sandbox (Go-native, in-process)                                  │\n│  └── Only installed by root                                              │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Level 1 — ENGINE PLUGINS (Graph, AI, GEOINT, Threat, Fusion)            │\n│  ├── Network: allow to databases + brokers only                          │\n│  ├── Filesystem: read /config, write /data/{plugin_id}                  │\n│  ├── Sandbox: cgroup v2 (memory: 2GB, cpu: 4 cores)                    │\n│  └── Signed: must be signed by osiris-engines key                        │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Level 2 — WORKER PLUGINS (graph-worker, ai-worker, etc.)                │\n│  ├── Network: allow to Kafka only                                        │\n│  ├── Filesystem: read-only /config                                       │\n│  ├── Sandbox: cgroup v2 (memory: 1GB, cpu: 2 cores)                    │\n│  └── Signed: must be signed by osiris-workers key                        │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Level 3 — SERVICE PLUGINS (Intel Server, Event Bus, Sensors)            │\n│  ├── Network: allow to specific external services (Shodan, OpenSky)     │\n│  ├── Filesystem: read-only /config, /data/{plugin_id}/tmp               │\n│  ├── Sandbox: Docker container (read-only rootfs, no --privileged)       │\n│  └── Signed: recommended but not required                                │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Level 4 — USER PLUGINS (installed by analyst/admin)                     │\n│  ├── Network: deny by default, allow-list required                       │\n│  ├── Filesystem: /data/{plugin_id} only, no /config                     │\n│  ├── Sandbox: Docker container (strict, no --cap-add)                   │\n│  ├── Signed: required (or warning flag)                                  │\n│  └── CPU/memory: strict limits (256MB, 1 core)                          │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Level 5 — UNTRUSTED PLUGINS (community, third-party)                    │\n│  ├── Network: deny all external (broker only via CP proxy)               │\n│  ├── Filesystem: tmpfs only, no persistent storage                       │\n│  ├── Sandbox: WASM (wazero) or Docker with seccomp=native-calls         │\n│  ├── Signed: mandatory (by osiris-community key)                        │\n│  ├── CPU/memory: strict limits (128MB, 0.5 core)                        │\n│  └── Manual review required before activation                            │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 5.2 Plugin Manifest Security Section\n\n```json\n{\n  \"security\": {\n    \"level\": 2,\n    \"signature\": {\n      \"algorithm\": \"ECDSA-P256\",\n      \"signer\": \"osiris-engines\",\n      \"signature\": \"base64_encoded_signature\",\n      \"certificate_chain\": [\"/etc/osiris/certs/engines-ca.crt\"],\n      \"signed_at\": \"2026-06-17T12:00:00Z\",\n      \"manifest_hash\": \"sha256:abc123...\"\n    },\n    \"network\": {\n      \"allow\": [\"kafka:9092\", \"graph-engine:9002\"],\n      \"deny\": [\"*\"]\n    },\n    \"filesystem\": {\n      \"read\": [\"/config\", \"/data/shared\"],\n      \"write\": [\"/data/ai-engine\"],\n      \"exec\": false\n    },\n    \"capabilities\": {\n      \"linux\": {\n        \"drop\": [\"ALL\"],\n        \"add\": []\n      },\n      \"seccomp\": {\n        \"profile\": \"default.json\",\n        \"allow\": [\"read\", \"write\", \"exit\", \"futex\", \"mmap\", \"munmap\"]\n      }\n    },\n    \"resources\": {\n      \"memory_mb\": 1024,\n      \"cpu_cores\": 2,\n      \"pids\": 256,\n      \"network_bandwidth_mbps\": 100,\n      \"disk_mb\": 512\n    },\n    \"audit\": {\n      \"log_all_capability_calls\": false,\n      \"log_resource_access\": true,\n      \"log_network_connections\": true\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. Audit & Compliance Logging System\n\n### 6.1 Audit Log Schema\n\n```json\n{\n  \"osiris:audit:v2\": {\n    \"meta\": {\n      \"audit_id\": \"aud_01J2XYZ...\",\n      \"timestamp\": \"2026-06-17T12:34:56.789Z\",\n      \"event_type\": \"authorization.decision\"\n    },\n    \"identity\": {\n      \"user_id\": \"usr_analyst_01\",\n      \"email\": \"analyst@osiris.io\",\n      \"roles\": [\"analyst\"],\n      \"auth_method\": \"jwt\",\n      \"session_id\": \"sess_01J2XYZ...\",\n      \"ip_address\": \"10.0.1.50\",\n      \"user_agent\": \"Mozilla/5.0...\",\n      \"geo\": {\n        \"country\": \"FR\",\n        \"city\": \"Paris\"\n      }\n    },\n    \"action\": {\n      \"type\": \"intelligence.query\",\n      \"resource\": \"graph.entity.ent_01J2XYZ...\",\n      \"action_detail\": \"MATCH (n) WHERE n.id = 'ent_01J2XYZ...' RETURN n\",\n      \"result\": \"allowed\",\n      \"reason\": \"role_permission_match\",\n      \"duration_ms\": 42\n    },\n    \"context\": {\n      \"request_id\": \"req_01J2XYZ...\",\n      \"trace_id\": \"trace_01J2XYZ...\",\n      \"investigation_id\": \"inv_01J2ABC...\",\n      \"tenant\": \"osiris-corp\",\n      \"environment\": \"production\"\n    },\n    \"security\": {\n      \"trust_score\": 85,\n      \"anomaly_score\": 0.02,\n      \"risk_level\": \"low\",\n      \"flags\": []\n    },\n    \"compliance\": {\n      \"data_classification\": \"tlp:amber\",\n      \"retention_days\": 365,\n      \"legal_hold\": false,\n      \"regulations\": [\"GDPR\", \"ISO27001\"]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 6.2 Audit Storage Architecture\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    AUDIT STORAGE ARCHITECTURE                             │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                          │\n│  Event Bus (Kafka) ──→ Audit Pipeline ──→ Storage ──→ Query API        │\n│       │                                         │            │           │\n│       ▼                                         ▼            ▼           │\n│  osiris.audit.*                           ClickHouse     Grafana        │\n│  (immutable, ordered)                     (columnar,      Explore        │\n│                                           partitioned     + Tempo       │\n│  Retention:                                by date)       traces         │\n│  - Hot (ClickHouse): 90 days                                            │\n│  - Warm (S3/OSS): 1 year                                                │\n│  - Cold (Glacier): 7 years (compliance)                                │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Partitioning:                                                          │\n│  - By date (YYYY-MM-DD)                                                 │\n│  - By tenant (multi-tenant)                                             │\n│  - By event_type (authorization, resource_access, system_change)        │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Immutability:                                                          │\n│  - Audit logs are APPEND-ONLY (no UPDATE, no DELETE)                    │\n│  - Each batch has a SHA256 hash of previous batch (chain)               │\n│  - Tamper detection: hash mismatch → alert                             │\n│  - Periodic checksums stored in separate tamper-proof store             │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 6.3 Audit Event Types\n\n| Event Type | Description | Retention | Compliance Relevance |\n|------------|-------------|-----------|---------------------|\n| `audit.auth.login` | User login attempt (success/failure) | 1 year | GDPR art. 33 |\n| `audit.auth.logout` | User logout | 1 year | — |\n| `audit.auth.token_refresh` | Token refresh | 90 days | — |\n| `audit.auth.mfa` | MFA challenge result | 1 year | SOX |\n| `audit.authorization.decision` | Allow/deny for any action | 1 year | ISO27001 A.9 |\n| `audit.resource.access` | Access to sensitive entity/data | 1 year | GDPR art. 15 |\n| `audit.resource.modify` | Create/update/delete entity | 3 years | GDPR art. 17 |\n| `audit.resource.export` | Data export/download | 3 years | GDPR art. 20 |\n| `audit.admin.user_create` | User account creation | 7 years | SOX |\n| `audit.admin.role_change` | Role/permission modification | 7 years | SOX |\n| `audit.admin.config_change` | System configuration change | 3 years | ISO27001 A.12 |\n| `audit.module.register` | Plugin/engine registration | 3 years | — |\n| `audit.module.stop` | Engine/worker stopped | 1 year | — |\n| `audit.module.start` | Engine/worker started | 1 year | — |\n| `audit.plugin.install` | Plugin installed | 3 years | — |\n| `audit.plugin.update` | Plugin updated | 3 years | — |\n| `audit.security.anomaly` | Detected anomalous behavior | 1 year | — |\n| `audit.security.override` | Admin override of security policy | 7 years | SOX |\n| `audit.compliance.hold` | Legal hold applied/released | 7 years + hold | eDiscovery |\n\n### 6.4 Alerting Rules (Security)\n\n```yaml\ngroups:\n  - name: osiris-security\n    rules:\n      - alert: BruteForceLogin\n        expr: rate(osiris_audit_auth_login{result=\"failure\"}[5m]) > 10\n        for: 1m\n        labels: { severity: critical }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Brute force login detected: {{ $value }} failures/min\"\n\n      - alert: SuspiciousPrivilegeEscalation\n        expr: osiris_audit_authorization_decision{result=\"denied\",reason=\"no_permission\"} > 50\n        for: 5m\n        labels: { severity: warning }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Multiple denied access attempts from {{ $labels.user_id }}\"\n\n      - alert: UntrustedPluginInstalled\n        expr: osiris_audit_plugin_install{security_level=\"5\"} > 0\n        for: 0m\n        labels: { severity: warning }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Untrusted plugin {{ $labels.plugin_id }} installed by {{ $labels.user_id }}\"\n\n      - alert: AuditTamperDetected\n        expr: osiris_audit_chain_hash_mismatch > 0\n        for: 0m\n        labels: { severity: critical }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Audit log tampering detected at {{ $labels.timestamp }}\"\n\n      - alert: TokenRevokedUsed\n        expr: osiris_auth_revoked_token_used > 0\n        for: 0m\n        labels: { severity: critical }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Revoked token attempted: user={{ $labels.user_id }}\"\n\n      - alert: HighRiskAction\n        expr: osiris_audit_authorization_decision{risk_level=\"high\"} > 5\n        for: 1m\n        labels: { severity: warning }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"{{ $value }} high-risk actions by {{ $labels.user_id }}\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Zero-Trust Architecture Summary\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    ZERO-TRUST ARCHITECTURE PRINCIPLES                     │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                          │\n│  Principle 1: Never Trust, Always Verify                                │\n│  ├── Every request authenticated (JWT, API Key, mTLS)                    │\n│  ├── Every request authorized (RBAC + trust score)                      │\n│  └── No implicit trust for internal traffic (mTLS everywhere)           │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Principle 2: Least Privilege                                            │\n│  ├── Each role has minimum required permissions                          │\n│  ├── Each plugin has minimum required network/filesystem access         │\n│  ├── Each engine can only reach its required databases                   │\n│  └── Tokens expire after 15 minutes (short-lived)                       │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Principle 3: Assume Breach                                              │\n│  ├── Full audit logging of every action                                 │\n│  ├── Immutable audit trail (tamper-evident chain)                       │\n│  ├── Anomaly detection on auth patterns                                  │\n│  ├── Token revocation on suspicious activity                             │\n│  └── Plugin isolation (crash doesn't propagate)                         │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Principle 4: Micro-segmentation                                         │\n│  ├── Network policies per engine (allow-list only)                       │\n│  ├── Filesystem isolation per plugin                                     │\n│  ├── Process isolation (cgroup v2, Docker, WASM)                        │\n│  └── Database access controlled per service account                      │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Principle 5: Secure by Default                                          │\n│  ├── All ports closed by default                                         │\n│  ├── All filesystems read-only by default                                │\n│  ├── All network egress denied by default                                │\n│  ├── All capability calls audited by default                             │\n│  └── Exceptions must be explicitly granted in manifest                   │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n## 8. Summary\n\n| Component | Technology | Purpose |\n|-----------|------------|---------|\n| **API Gateway** | Python FastAPI (upgraded) | JWT validation, RBAC, audit, rate limiting, route proxying |\n| **Auth Provider** | pkg/trust (Go) | Trust scoring, identity graph, ABAC policy engine |\n| **JWT Management** | RS256, 15min TTL, Redis deny-list | Short-lived tokens with instant revocation |\n| **Refresh Tokens** | 7d TTL, device-bound | Session persistence without re-authentication |\n| **API Keys** | Hashed + scoped per key | Machine-to-machine auth |\n| **SSO** | OIDC adapter (Keycloak/Okta) | Enterprise identity federation |\n| **mTLS** | Internal CA (osiris-ca) | Service-to-service authentication |\n| **RBAC** | 7 roles, 30 permissions | Hierarchical role model with granular permissions |\n| **Plugin Security** | 6 security levels (0-5) | Network/filesystem/resource isolation per plugin |\n| **Plugin Signing** | ECDSA-P256 | Code integrity verification |\n| **Audit Storage** | ClickHouse (hot) + S3 (warm) + Glacier (cold) | Tiered storage, 7-year retention |\n| **Audit Immutability** | SHA256 chain hashing | Tamper-evident audit log |\n| **Security Alerts** | Prometheus + Alertmanager | 6 security alert rules |\n| **WebSocket Auth** | JWT on connect | Real-time auth for streaming data |\n\n**Key Design Decisions**:\n\n| Decision | Rationale |\n|----------|-----------|\n| **Upgrade existing gateway** (not rebuild) | JWT + FastAPI already deployed; needs RBAC middleware, trust score bridge, refresh tokens |\n| **Bridge gateway → pkg/trust via gRPC** | pkg/trust (Go) already has Authorizer, TrustScoringEngine, IdentityGraph — don't reimplement |\n| **RS256 over HS256** | HS256 uses shared secret (symmetric) — compromised [REDACTED:ENV_VAR] tokens. RS256 uses key pair |\n| **Redis deny-list over JWT blacklist** | O(1) lookup, auto-expiry (matches TTL), no need for per-request DB check |\n| **6 plugin security levels** | Matches natural trust hierarchy (system → engine → worker → service → user → untrusted) |\n| **Dual Write: Kafka + ClickHouse for audit** | Kafka provides ordered, replayable event stream; ClickHouse provides fast analytical queries |\n| **SHA256 chain for audit immutability** | Bitcoin-inspired — each block hash includes previous block hash; tampering breaks chain |\n| **Trust score as auth factor** | Risk-based — low trust = elevated auth requirements (MFA), high trust = faster path |","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

Logging Strategy\n\n### 3.1 Log Levels & Format\n\n```json\n{\n  \"logging\": {\n    \"format\": \"JSON (structured, not plain text)\",\n    \"levels\": {\n      \"debug\":   \"Detailed diagnostic info (off in production)\",\n      \"info\":    \"Normal operation events\",\n      \"warn\":    \"Unexpected but non-critical (retry, degradation)\",\n      \"error\":   \"Operation failed, needs investigation\",\n      \"fatal\":   \"Unrecoverable, process exiting (immediate alert)\"\n    },\n    \"fields\": {\n      \"timestamp\": \"2026-06-17T12:34:56.789Z\",\n      \"level\": \"info\",\n      \"logger\": \"graph-engine\",\n      \"module_id\": \"graph-engine\",\n      \"trace_id\": \"trace_abc123...\",\n      \"span_id\": \"span_def456...\",\n      \"correlation_id\": \"corr_xyz789...\",\n      \"message\": \"Entity 45.33.22.1 stored in Memgraph (3 edges created)\",\n      \"engine\": \"graph-engine\",\n      \"entity_id\": \"ent_45.33.22.1\",\n      \"duration_ms\": 42,\n      \"error\": null\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 3.2 Log Shipping Architecture\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    LOG SHIPPING ARCHITECTURE                              │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ │\n│  │                      │     │                      │                 │\n│  │  log.Info({          │     │  log.info({          │                 │\n│  │    \"message\": \"...\", │     │    \"message\": \"...\", │                 │\n│  │    \"trace_id\": x     │     │    \"trace_id\": x     │                 │\n│  │  })                  │     │  })                  │                 │\n│  │                      │     │                      │                 │\n│  │  stdout → container  │     │  stdout → container  │                 │\n│  │         logs         │     │         logs Docker logging driver      │  Docker logging driver      │\n│             │  (loki: λ)                  │  (loki: λ)                  │\n│             ▼                            ▼ │\n│  │  │                                                             │  │   │\n│  │  │  {compose_project=\"osiris\", compose_service=\"graph-engine\"} │  │   │\n│  │  │  {compose_project=\"osiris\", compose_service=\"ai-engine\"}    │  │   │\n│  │  │  {compose_project=\"osiris\", compose_service=\"geoint-engine\"}│  │   │\n│  │  │  {compose_project=\"osiris\", compose_service=\"frontend\"}    │  │   │\n│  │  │  {compose_project=\"osiris\", compose_service=\"gateway\"}     │  │   │\n│  │  │  ...                                                        │  │   │\n│  │  │                                                             │  │   │\n│  │  │  LogQL queries:                                             │  │   │\n│  │  │  {compose_service=\"graph-engine\"} |= \"error\"               │  │   │\n│  │  │  {compose_project=\"osiris\"} |= \"correlation_id=\\\"corr_x\\\"\"│  │   │\n│  │  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │   │\n│  │                                                                   │   │\n│  │  Retention: 30 days (hot)                                        │   │\n│  │  Object storage (S3): 1 year                                     │   │\n│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 3.3 Log Query Patterns\n\n```logql\n// All errors in last 1h across all engines\n{compose_project=\"osiris\"} |= \"error\" | json | unwrap duration_ms | avg() by (compose_service)\n\n// Trace a specific correlation_id across engines\n{compose_project=\"osiris\"} | json | correlation_id = \"corr_xyz789\"\n\n// Find all events for a specific entity\n{compose_project=\"osiris\"} | json | entity_id = \"ent_45.33.22.1\"\n\n// Slow operations (>1s) in any engine\n{compose_project=\"osiris\"} | json | duration_ms > 1000 | pattern \"<level> <message>\"\n\n// Errors by engine (top 5)\ntopk(5, sum by (compose_service) (count_over_time({compose_project=\"osiris\"} |= \"error\"[1h])))\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. [frontend]   1315ms ── 1650ms │   │\n│  │                                                                    │   │\n│  │  Attributes propagated across ALL spans:                          │   │\n│  │  ├── correlation_id = \"corr_xyz789\"                               │   │\n│  │  ├── entity_id = \"ent_45.33.22.1\"                                 │   │\n│  │  ├── entity_type = \"ip_address\"                                   │   │\n│  │  ├── tenant = \"osiris-corp\"                                       │   │\n│  │  └── pipeline_stage = \"full_enrichment\"                          │   │\n│  │                      │\n│  Trace Export:                                                          │\n│  ──────────────                                                         │\n│  All engines use OpenTelemetry Go SDK:                                 │\n│  import \"go.opentelemetry.io/otel\"                                     │\n│  tracer := otel.Tracer(\"graph-engine\")                                 │\n│  ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, \"graph.store\",                         │\n│    trace.WithAttributes(                                                │\n│      attribute.String(\"entity_id\", entity.Id),                         │\n│      attribute.Int(\"edges\", len(entity.Edges)),                        │\n│    ),                                                                  │\n│  )                                                                     │\n│  defer span.End()                                                      │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Exporter: OTLP gRPC → Tempo (already deployed)                       │\n│  Batch interval: 5s or 100 spans                                      │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 4.2 Span Attributes (Standardized)\n\n```json\n{\n  \"required_attributes\": {\n    \"correlation_id\": \"string — links events across engines\",\n    \"entity_id\": \"string — entity being processed (if applicable)\",\n    \"entity_type\": \"string — domain, ip, threat_actor, etc.\",\n    \"engine\": \"string — engine name\",\n    \"engine_version\": \"string — semantic version\"\n  },\n  \"optional_attributes\": {\n    \"pipeline_stage\": \"string — enrichment stage number\",\n    \"db_query\": \"string — cypher/SQL query (truncated if >1KB)\",\n    \"http_method\": \"string — for gateway spans\",\n    \"http_path\": \"string — for gateway spans\",\n    \"http_status_code\": \"int — for gateway spans\",\n    \"error\": \"bool — whether span errored\",\n    \"error_message\": \"string — error details\"\n  },\n  \"span_kinds\": {\n    \"engine\": \"SpanKind.Internal — core engine processing\",\n    \"gateway\": \"SpanKind.Server — HTTP request handling\",\n    \"worker\": \"SpanKind.Consumer — Kafka consumer processing\",\n    \"db\": \"SpanKind.Client — database query execution\",\n    \"plugin\": \"SpanKind.Internal — plugin capability execution\",\n    \"ui\": \"SpanKind.Consumer — frontend event processing\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Alerting System Design\n\n### 5.1 Alert Categories\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    ALERT CATEGORIES AND SEVERITY                          │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                          │\n│  SEVERITY LEVELS:                                                       │\n│  ─────────────────                                                       │\n│  🔴 CRITICAL — System degraded, human must respond within 5min         │\n│  🟠 HIGH     — Significant issue, respond within 30min                 │\n│  🟡 WARNING  — Potential issue developing, respond within 4h           │\n│  🔵 INFO     — Informational, no immediate action needed               │\n│                                                                          │\n│  CATEGORIES:                                                             │\n│  ───────────                                                             │\n│                                                                          │\n│  🔴 SYSTEM HEALTH                                                        │\n│  ├── EngineDown: Engine not responding for >30s                         │\n│  ├── WorkerDown: Worker consumer group has 0 members                    │\n│  ├── DatabaseDown: Database connection failed >15s                      │\n│  ├── KafkaBrokerDown: Kafka producer timeout >30s                       │\n│  └── ControlPlaneDown: Cannot reach control plane >10s                  │\n│                                                                          │\n│  🟠 PERFORMANCE                                                          │\n│  ├── HighEventLag: name: osiris-system-health\n    interval: 30s\n    rules:\n      - alert: EngineDown\n        expr: osiris_engine_up == 0\n        for: 30s\n        labels: { severity: critical }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Engine {{ $labels.engine }} is down\"\n          description: \"Engine {{ $labels.engine }} has not reported for 30s. Last heartbeat: {{ $value }}\"\n\n      - alert: DatabaseDown\n        expr: osiris_db_connections == 0\n        for: 15s\n        labels: { severity: critical }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Database {{ $labels.db }} is unreachable\"\n\n      - alert: ControlPlaneDown\n        expr: osiris_engine_up{engine=\"control-plane\"} == 0\n        for: 10s\n        labels: { severity: critical }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Control Plane is down — system cannot be orchestrated\"\n\n  - name: osiris-performance\n    interval: 30s\n    rules:\n      - alert: HighEventLag\n        expr: osiris_events_lag{topic=~\"osiris\\\\.threat\\\\..*|osiris\\\\.ioc\\\\..*\"} > 1000\n        for: 2m\n        labels: { severity: high }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"High event lag on {{ $labels.topic }}: {{ $value }} messages\"\n\n      - alert: HighErrorRate\n        expr: rate(osiris_engine_errors_total[5m]) / rate(osiris_engine_requests_total[5m]) > 0.05\n        for: 5m\n        labels: { severity: high }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Error rate on {{ $labels.engine }}: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}\"\n\n      - alert: HighMemoryUsage\n        expr: osiris_engine_memory_bytes / on(engine) osiris_engine_memory_limit_bytes > 0.85\n        for: 5m\n        labels: { severity: warning }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Memory usage on {{ $labels.engine }}: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}\"\n\n      - alert: HighEventLatency\n        expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(osiris_events_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) > 5000\n        for: 5m\n        labels: { severity: warning }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"P99 latency on {{ $labels.topic }}: {{ $value }}ms\"\n\n  - name: osiris-intelligence-quality\n    interval: 60s\n    rules:\n      - alert: DataStaleness\n        expr: time() - osiris_intel_entities_last_update > 86400\n        for: 1h\n        labels: { severity: warning }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Entity type {{ $labels.entity_type }} has entities not updated for >24h\"\n\n      - alert: FalsePositiveSpike\n        expr: osiris_intel_false_positive_rate > 0.10\n        for: 15m\n        labels: { severity: warning }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"False positive rate on {{ $labels.engine }}: {{ $value }}\"\n\n      - alert: PipelineFailure\n        expr: rate(osiris_intel_pipeline_failures_total[5m]) > 5\n        for: 5m\n        labels: { severity: high }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Pipeline failures on stage {{ $labels.pipeline_stage }}: {{ $value }}/min\"\n\n      - alert: SchemaMismatch\n        expr: rate(osiris_events_dlq_total{error_type=\"schema_validation_error\"}[5m]) > 0\n        for: 1m\n        labels: { severity: high }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Schema validation errors on {{ $labels.topic }}\"\n\n  - name: osiris-operational\n    interval: 60s\n    rules:\n      - alert: PluginInstalled\n        expr: rate(osiris_plugin_registrations_total[5m]) > 0\n        for: 0m\n        labels: { severity: info }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Plugin {{ $labels.plugin_id }} installed by {{ $labels.user_id }}\"\n\n      - alert: EngineRestarted\n        expr: changes(osiris_engine_uptime_seconds[5m]) > 0\n        for: 0m\n        labels: { severity: info }\n        annotations:\n          summary: \"Engine {{ $labels.engine }} restarted\"\n```\n\n### 5.3 Alert Routing & Notification\n\n```yaml\n# Alertmanager configuration\nroute:\n  receiver: \"default\"\n  group_by: [\"alertname\", \"severity\"]\n  group_wait: 10s\n  group_interval: 2m\n  repeat_interval: 1h\n  routes:\n    - Failure Detection System\n\n### 6.1 Multi-Stage Detection\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    FAILURE DETECTION PIPELINE                             │\n├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤\n│                                                                          │\n│  Stage 1: Heartbeat (10s interval)                                      │\n│  ────────────────────────────────────                                    │\n│  Each engine sends heartbeat via gRPC to Control Plane every 10s        │\n│  Control Plane tracks last_heartbeat in registry                        │\n│  Threshold: no heartbeat for 30s → engine marked \"unhealthy\"            │\n│  Threshold: no heartbeat for 60s → engine marked \"down\"                 │\n│  Action: Alert (EngineDown) + auto-restart attempt                      │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Stage 2: Health Check (30s interval)                                   │\n│  ────────────────────────────────────────                                │\n│  Control Plane pings /health endpoint every 30s                        │\n│  Each engine returns: {\"status\": \"ok\", \"version\": \"2.1.0\", ...}        │\n│  Failed check → immediate retry (3 attempts, 5s apart)                  │\n│  3 failures → engine marked \"degraded\"                                  │\n│  6 failures → engine marked \"unhealthy\"                                 │\n│  Action: Alert (EngineDegraded) + circuit breaker engagement            │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Stage 3: Synthetic Probe (5min interval)                               │\n│  ────────────────────────────────────────                                │\n│  Control Plane sends synthetic event through pipeline:                  │\n│  Probe event → Engine A → Engine B → ... → Engine Z → result back      │\n│  Measures end-to-end latency + data correctness                         │\n│  Probe failure → individual engine validation                           │\n│  Action: Alert (PipelineDegraded) + per-engine diagnostics              │\n│                                                                          │\n│  Stage 4: Anomaly Detection (continuous)                                │\n│  ────────────────────────────────────                                   │\n│  Baseline metrics per engine (last 7 days):                             │\n│  - Request rate (avg + 3σ threshold)                                   │\n│  - Error rate (avg + 2σ threshold)                                     │\n│  - Latency p50/p95/p99 (avg + 2σ threshold)                            │\n│  - Event lag (trending up >10min)                                      │\n│  - Memory usage (trending up >15min)                                   │\n│  Anomaly detection via Prometheus + recorded rules                      │\n│  Action: Alert (AnomalyDetected) + auto-scaling or investigation        │\n│                                                                          │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### 6.2 Performance Bottleneck Detection\n\n```json\n{\n  \"bottleneck_detection\": {\n    \"method\": under-provisioned\",\n        \"action\": \"Increase consumer count in consumer group\"\n      },\n      {\n        \"scenario\": \"Engine CPU high + latency high + lag growing\",\n        \"cause\": \"Engine throughput exhausted\",\n        \"action\": \"Scale engine horizontally (add replicas)\"\n      },\n      {\n        \"scenario\": \"Engine CPU low + latency high + I/O wait high\",\n pipeline stage consistently slowest\",\n        \"cause\": \"Stage-specific bottleneck (e.g., AI inference)\",\n        \"action\": \"Optimize stage (batch, cache, model optimization)\"\n      },\n Summary\n\n| Component | Technology | Purpose |\n|-----------|------------|---------|\n| **Metrics** | Prometheus + Pushgateway | Pull model for Go engines, push for Python/Node.js plugins |\n| **Logs** | Loki + Docker logging driver | Structured JSON logs, 30-day retention, LogQL queries |\n| **Traces** | OpenTelemetry Go SDK → Tempo | Distributed tracing per correlation_id, OTLP export |\n| **Dashboards** | Grafana (8 dashboards) | System overview, per-engine, event bus, intelligence quality, security, tracing, frontend |\n| **Alerting** | Prometheus Alertmanager → PagerDuty + Slack | 4 severity levels, 20+ alert rules, escalation routing |\n| **Failure Detection** | 4-stage pipeline (heartbeat → health → synthetic probe → anomaly) | Multi-layer detection with auto-remediation |\n| **Quality Monitoring** | 6 composite metrics (completeness, freshness, accuracy, coverage, latency, consistency) | Real-time intelligence quality scoring |\n| **Bottleneck Detection** | Correlation engine + 6 detection scenarios | Automated root cause identification |\n\n**Key Design Decisions**:\n\n| Decision | Rationale |\n|----------|-----------|\n| **OpenTelemetry for traces** (not Zipkin, not Jaeger) | Vendor-neutral, Go SDK maturity, Tempo already deployed, single exporter for metrics+logs+traces |\n| **Prometheus pull for Go, Pushgateway for Python/Node.js** | Go engines are long-lived with known endpoints; Python/Node.js plugins are ephemeral workers with dynamic ports |\n| **Structured JSON logs everywhere** | Enables LogQL parsing across all services; single format for Loki indexing |\n| **Correlation ID as trace root** | Maps directly to the event-driven architecture; every event has a correlation_id → natural trace parent |\n| **4-stage failure detection** | No single point of failure in detection; heartbeat catches crashes, health checks catch degradation, synthetic probes catch pipeline issues, anomaly detection catches silent failures |\n| **Intelligence quality as a metric** (not just infra health) | Ensures data correctness, not just system uptime — critical for OSINT platform credibility |\n| **Dual Write: Kafka + Prometheus for events** | Kafka provides ordered replay, Prometheus provides instant querying; both needed for observability |","operationIsLocatedInWorkspace":true,"startLineNumbers":[]}

**Architecture:**
```
                      ┌──────────────────────┐
                      │     osiris-event-bus   │
                      │  (in-memory pub/sub)   │
                      └──────┬───────────┬────┘
                             │           │
                    ┌────────▼──┐  ┌─────▼─────────┐
                    │ Redis     │  │ Kafka          │
                    │ Streams   │  │ (Go backends)  │
                    │ (Python)  │  │                │
                    └───────────┘  └────────────────┘
```

**Wiring coverage:**

| Layer | Modules wired | Topics subscribed | Events published |
|-------|--------------|-------------------|------------------|
| Engines | 12 (ai,graph,geoint,security,fusion,workflow,kafka,stream,ingest,kernel,trust,evolution) | 8-12 per engine | 2-5 per engine |
| Workers | 14 (ai,geoint,graph,threat,incident-replay,orchestrator,predictive,digitaltwin,reward-engine,selfhealing,selfrewrite,cp-engine,core) | 1-3 per worker | 1 per worker |
| Services | 10 (core-brain,event-bus,tracking,ai-engine,meta-orchestration,osiris-agent,osiris-brain,kernel,sensors,cp) | 2-4 per service | 1-2 per service |
| UI | All panels, shells, workspaces, views, machines, hooks, contracts | 2-8 per module | 1 per module |
| Gateway | `gateway:main` | 2 | 2 |
| Intel | `intel:server` | 1 | 3 |
| Control Plane | `control-plane:registry` | 6 | 4 |

**Key properties:**
- Every `emit()` carries `correlationId` (auto-generated if not provided)
- Wildcard `osiris:*` subscriptions for system-wide listeners
- Lazy auto-connect to Redis and Kafka (runtime imports, not npm deps)

**`control-plane/bootstrap.ts` — Control Plane Bootstrap Delivered**

Single entry point (488 lines) that boots the entire OSIRIS v2 system:

**Boot sequence (5 phases):**

| Phase | Action | Output |
|-------|--------|--------|
| 1/5 | Validate module registry | `registry.validate()` — checks all bindings |
| 2/5 | Initialize Event Bus | `bootEventBus()` — dual transport (Redis + Kafka) |
| 3/5 | Register modules | LifecycleManager registers all active modules |
| 4/5 | Start in dependency order | Gateway → Engines → Services → Workers |
| 5/5 | Verify health | Health summary with scoring |

**Runtime API:**

| Method | Signature | Description |
|--------|-----------|-------------|
| `startModule` | `(id: string) => ModuleRuntime` | Start a single module |
| `stopModule` | `(id: string) => ModuleRuntime` | Stop a single module |
| `reloadModule` | `(id: string) => ModuleRuntime` | Reload (stop + start) |
| `getModule` | `(id: string) => ModuleRuntime \| undefined` | Get runtime state |
| `getModulesByType` | `(type: ModuleType) => ModuleRuntime[]` | Filter by type |
| `getAllModules` | `() => ModuleRuntime[]` | All runtimes |
| `getFailedModules` | `() => ModuleRuntime[]` | Error-state modules |
| `getHealth` | `() => HealthSummary` | Full health report |
| `onLifecycleEvent` | `(handler) => () => void` | Subscribe to lifecycle events |
| `getEventBus` | `() => EventBus` | Access event bus |
| `getRegistry` | `() => Registry` | Access registry |

**LifecycleManager features:**
- Module state machine: `stopped → starting → running → (degraded|error|reloading)`
- Health check pings every 15s via `osiris:cp:health` topic
- Health score (0.0–1.0) with decay on errors
- Event counters per module (processed/emitted)
- Lifecycle event subscription for observability

|------|-------|---------|
| `control-plane/registry.ts` | 790 | Module inventory + validation |
| `control-plane/event-bus.ts` | 817 | Dual-transport event wiring |
| `control-plane/bootstrap.ts` | 488 | Boot + lifecycle + runtime API |
| `frontend/runtime/ui-registry.ts` | 238 | UI component registry |
| **Total** | **2,333** | **Complete runtime system** |HAS_CHANGES

  size=$(wc -c < "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  # Classify by title pattern
  if echo "$first" | grep -q "ui\|dashboard\|frontend\|react\|visualization\|ux"; then
    echo "UI       $size $f"
  elif echo "$first" | grep -q "event\|stream\|real.time\|log\|pipeline"; then
    echo "EVENT    $size $f"
  elif echo "$first" | grep -q "workflow\|orchestrat\|binding\|engine\|kernel\|plugin"; then
    echo "WORKFLOW $size $f"
  elif echo "$first" | grep -q "tool\|script\|cli\|api\|sdk"; then
    echo "TOOL     $size $f"
  elif echo "$first" | grep -q "audit\|report\|review\|plan\|roadmap\|spec\|design\|architecture\|security\|index"; then
    echo "JUNK     $size $f"
  else
    echo "OTHER    $size $f"
  fi
done | sort -k2 -rn | head -80

=> {\n      const mid = event.payload.moduleId as string\n      if (!mid) return\n      this.recordHeartbeat(mid, event)\n    })\n\n    eventBus.subscribe('adapter:health-scoring', 'osiris:system', Periodic health recalculation\n    setInterval(() => this.recalculateAll(), 30000)\n    console.log('[adapter:health-scoring] Started')\n  }\n\n  recordHeartbeat(moduleId: string, event: OsirisEvent): ({\n          name, weight, current: 1.0, threshold: 0.5,\n        })),\n        lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),\n        status: 'healthy',\n      }\n      this.moduleHealth.set(moduleId, mh)\n    }\n    mh.lastUpdated = new Date().toISOString()\n    mh.factors.find(f => f.name === 'uptime')!.current = Math.min(1.0, mh.factors.find(f => f.name === 'uptime')!.current + 0.01)\n 'responseTime')!.current)\n    this.updateScore(moduleId)\n  }\n\n  recordError(moduleId: string): void {\n    const mh = this.moduleHealth.get(moduleId)\n    if (!mh) return\n    mh.factors.find(f => const mh = this.moduleHealth.get(moduleId)\n    if (!mh) return\n    let score = 0\n    for (const f of mh.factors) score += f.weight * f.current\n    mh.score = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, score)) * 100) / 100\n    mh.status = mh.score >= 0.8 ? 'healthy' : mh.score >= 0.5 ? 'degraded' : 'critical'\n  }\n\n  private recalculateAll(): void {\n    for (const [id, mh] of this.moduleHealth) {\n      this.updateScore(id)\n      // Emit health score update\n      eventBus.emit(\n        'osiris:system',\n        'health.score.changed',\n        { moduleId: id, score: mh.score, status: mh.status, factors: mh.factors },\n        'health-scoring-engine',\n        mh.status === 'critical' ? DashboardRealtimeEngine {\n  private bandingMs: number\n  private buffer: Array<DashboardEvent> = []\n  private bandingTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null\n  private stats = { routed: this.scheduleFlush()\n    })\n\n    console.log('[adapter:realtime-events] Started')\n  }\n\n  route(cpEvent: OsirisEvent): DashboardEvent[] {\n    const results: DashboardEvent[] = []\n    const dashType = EVENT_MAP[cpEvent.type]\n    if (dashType) {\n      results.push({\n        event_id: `dsh_${cpEvent.id.slice(0, 12)}`,\n        event_type: dashType,\n        timestamp: cpEvent.timestamp,\n        server_time: new Date().toISOString(),\n        source: cpEvent.source,\n        severity: cpEvent.severity,\n        correlation_id: cpEvent.correlationId,\n void {\n    this.running = false\n    if (this.bandingTimer) { clearTimeout(this.bandingTimer); this.bandingTimer = null }\n    this.flush()\n    console.log('[adapter:realtime-events] Stopped. reason: string } {\n    if (!this.enabled) return { allowed: true, reason: 'gateway disabled' }\n    if (this.isBlocked(moduleId)) return { allowed: false, reason: `module ${moduleId} is blocked` }\n    return securityGuard.authorizeSubscribe(moduleId, topic)\n  }\n\n  enforceModuleExec(sourceModuleId: string, targetModuleId: string): { allowed: boolean; System-wide security enforcement implemented with zero-trust architecture.

| Check | Where | Mechanism |
|-------|-------|-----------|

| Cross-module call prevention | `securityGuard.authorizeModuleExec()` | Source identity + target module resource check |
| Block list | `gatewayEnforcer.blockModule()` | Hard block on malicious modules |
| Rate limiting | `gatewayEnforcer.checkRateLimit()` | 100 events/minute per module |
| Audit trail | `AuditChain` | SHA-256 immutable hash chain |
